I've been playing it for about two months, but the most recent update to crafting has really put me off. Weapons and robots need a total of 10,000 pieces to create in batches of 100, 200, 400. In addition to in game currency needed to create it, the packs would take 15, 25, or 35 minutes to craft respectively for the lowest times, and the highest times took 1.5 days to 3.5 days in total. Now, the 15 minute time has moved up to 1.5 days! The 1.5 days has increased to 3 days, and and the 3.5 days has increased to almost a week, just for 400/10,000 pieces. The whole point of this update was to create a system that let you build what you wanted and not need to worry about winning the lottery just to get the weapon or robot you wanted, and even though the new system had flaws, increasing the time by such a dramatic amount is contradictory to why they released it in the first place. The system is already unfavorable towards new players, but this has dramatically exacerbated the issue. Once it gets fixed, I would be happy to put the review up to 4-5 stars as it's still a fun game. But I find it pretty unreasonable to wait for a total of (10,000 pieces /400 pieces=25 total packs needed, 25 packs x 6 days = 150 days) just for one robot! Keep in mind that you can only have a maximum of 6 things building at one time, with only 3 able to be used by lower level players.

Haven't tried the new pilots mod added due to the game matchmaking lag, game closes me out, & expensive prices. No more money on this game mann .-.

The gameplay seems fine in the first 2-5 hours, but then the matchmaking makes you fight against some kind of alien technology you can only obtain with your wallet. Just like any other mobile game, War Robots is completely pay-to-win. I have spent a week to be able to upgrade my robot to the next level, just to be defeated by some kind of flying spaceship, with its "lightning cannons" that can fire across the whole map.

I've been playing on this app since 2018, and although I loved how it was engaging and fun, I'm sad to say my star review has dropped recently. I've never been a pay to win person, so I've been upgrading my hangar manually for the past couple years by grinding. But since so many high level robots are accessible for just cash, there's not a great balance to go up the ranks. Your entire team can get wiped out by an op cash driven robot hangar in mere minutes. And the amount of deals you skip.

I stopped playing the game around the time the Dashbots came out, when a heavy was something important. Recently picked it back up... Should never have done it. Came back to modules, flying robots, and titans. The modules are the worst. Essentially invincibility for several seconds...what's the point in even playing the game if, at champion level, I get face melted by an Ao Jun or get roasted by someone that I burn down and they are now invincible?

Would be great if you can balance out the price of weapons, bots, etc.. Since most of them have high price in Au (gold) and majority of the game is required to be paid by gold. Also the match-ups are quite unfair.. Most of the time, I have completely weak allies compared to advanced leveled bots and weapons of the enemies. It would be great if you can also adjust the match-up perhaps based on the individual's battle performance.

It's a fun game. Will admit, way too many in-app purchases in order to progress, but still a fun game to play. And even if there is free giveaways, those are just for robots and gear. What about the fact that there are like 7 different currencies that are all impossible to get without using money. I can barrely level up my robots at this point due to how hard it is to even grind for silver, let alone memorium, microchips, gold, and platinum. More balance needs to be brought to the game.

Lag in the game has made it useless, easily 2 to 3 seconds of delay now. I want my money back, dont waste your time if you're thinking of downloading and delete if you have downloaded. I've spent a lot of time and money on this game, It was enjoyable for a long time too, the recent "upgrades" have made the game prettier but unplayable. Uninstall and delete account.

Liked this game at one point. The developers likely made some money from advertisements from me and I just kept grinding. I eventually aquired some cool items and had fun but mostly got my butt kicked. Regardless, I still played and had some success against stronger opponents. Never once was I planning on "buying" anything. Now an update happens which means i cant even get into the game reliably. I just uninstalled. Maybe I'll try again, maybe not. Right now I'm pretty much done with it

I still love the game but I went from a paying customer to a free to play, after they took my gold (that I paid cash for) and converted it to Silver. Still haven't had any response from them. And I would recommend more brawling Maps, my suggestion would be a mining operation upon a large asteroid that you drop down into a Labyrinth of tunnels with multiple levels, I would like it so immense that First Time Players Get Lost. 😆😁

The game play is great. Graphics are very vibrant and realistic. The movement and action is fantastic. The earning really cool mechs and components is extremely slow and the constant attempts to upsell for silver, gold, keys, guns, mechs, hangars, components is all incredibly tedious. Why pay $100+ real money for a game on your phone? Buy a switch and pay $40 one time to play as much as you want. Dont get sucked into this game...

THIS IS PAY TO WIN. With all due respec, the game is great but the developers are just some bunch of mercenaries. You have just one kind of sub machine gun you can buy with "simple money", the biiig part of robots you can buy you can buy only with gold (cash), the upgrades you can make in weapons and robots never can beat the fkn premium robots. It is a shame, bc the game is really fun. I would rethink about the amount of money you have to pay just to get in the game.

I'm not going to lie, I flipping love this game. I've been playing for years and its quite literally the best mobile game I've ever played. Great graphics, controls, awesome bots and weapons. Pixonic updates the game constantly which is both good and bad. With that said, it is a major financial investment if you want to get meta bots, and meta weapons, especially for new players. The lag can occasionally be atrocious, and playing against the big pay to play opponents can get very frustrating.

Pay to win. And it's not Cheap! Horrible match making too. If your ok being someone else's moving target practice even after a few $100's spent on upgrades...then maybe you can stomach this game. But I dumped tons of $ to try to get to the level of the players I was being matched against. Only to keep getting mismatched. On top of all of that, there are tons of bugs in game play, misleading sales, and connection issues across the board! I cant say enough bad about this game. If you play, GL!

I posted a review a few years back saying that this was the best mobile game I had ever played. It was at the time but it's gone downhill. Upgrades take around 5 days when you get them to a high-ish level, when you are a free to play player like I was until recently it's basically impossible to get items to mark 2, let alone mark 3 which has just come out. The prices are extortionate (new robots and weapons could cost in the £90s) and when you open the game you have to close a load of pop ups.

Firstly, this game is heavily monetized. To the extend where you will get hit with 4-6 "offers" when you first sign in for the day. That being said, the gameplay is exceptional. It's fun to play and progress is made if you win or loose. The most powerful items in the game are won instead of purchased and don't trump skill. Play at your own risk as it does appeal to gambling addictions with its random loot box style system. Also the lag can be pretty bad sometimes. Please fix soon Pixonic.

(Great game, cool mechs and weapons. Like how u can upgrade everything. Its fun for a game or 2 or for a long longer.) Was my original post now this game is too far gone asking you to consistently spend money on "deals" is annoying and upgrading takes forever! A freaking week and 70-90 mil in some cases, you gotta be kidding me! They leave you with no choice but to spend real cash unless you want to be left behind. I understand they're in this to make money but it's becoming absurd at this point

Cool concept, but they absolutely cram the in-app purchases down your throat, every time I log in, I have to exit out of no fewer than 5 pages for "deal of the day". After a few weeks of playing, its obvious you need to spend serious real money if you hope to not get killed in seconds. Were not talking dropping 5 or 10 dollars every so often. Any robot costs hundreds of dollars to level up enough to be worth using. Just another greedy developer squeezing the community for every penny.

The game is no longer fun or about skill. Lag issues and recent additions ruined the game. The supposedly fixed targeting system still doesn't work worth a damn. Matchmaking is a problem. Weapons balance doesn't exist. Newer robots have multiple abilities that make fighting them impossible. Pay to win IS the name of the game, and the costs are WAY too high. Costs for weapons upgrades vary greatly for same level weapons, with HUGE upgrade costs for everything.

I used to play this game all the time. It was pretty awesome. But now with all the new robots and weapons it's really just pay to win. Mobile games are just for quick fun, but if you cant pay for anything then you have to grind, which I don't have the time for. Overall, please calm down on the offers and make it so that we can level up easier.

Great game where they add awesome features and then make it harder and harder, or very time consuming to build things for free. They really want you to buy everything. Not a good free to play. Not happy due to their workshop times increase. Need to implement a robot cloning function and extra lives for ppl who don't have multiple bays, or slots. Otherwise it's pay to win. Ask Google how long it takes to make/get a full robot, times that by 5.....

Edit: I've demoted my review to 3 stars because of one robot: the Hawk. It's everywhere, and it's too powerful. This game is a mountain for casual players, and a molehill for pay-to-win players. But is it possible to get into the Master League (the top league) with no payments? Yes. It takes forever, but yes. If you like fun game mechanics, screwy and stilted but good game play, and mech battles, this has a lot going for it. You CAN eventually get there, even without payment. Good luck!

I played this game for 3 - 4 years, I was f2p. It was hard but manageable for along time. I would routinely have an 8 - 12k rating each month depending on how much I played. Biggest problem is that you have 2 pay to get new stuff pretty much. Even with "guaranteed prizes" you seldom got new robots. Lastly if you don't pay 2 win you can never really compete because of Power Cells. You won't be able to use your modules and this more than anything unbalanced the game. Target and lag were bad too.

Unless you're willing to spend hundreds (yes, hundreds) of dollars, I wouldn't download this game. If you want to be even remotely competitive, you need to constantly spend money on upgrades, weapons, etc. Even after you buy upgrades, the game keeps placing you with harder players, forcing you to continue to spend more. The graphics and gameplay are decent though which is why I have it 2 stars instead of 1.

This game used to be great when it first came out. Simple, enjoyable and required a little practice to get familiar with various weapons and robots. Also good map design. However I can in no way reccomend playing this as it currently is as the overwhelming amount of microtransactions has turned the game into textbook PLAY TO WIN. Almost no skill required, impossible to grind your way and enjoy the game as the only way to become a "good" player is to sink several hundred bucks into the game!1/5

I liked the game but $$$ for one robot and 5$ per weapon is just too much. After the last update, gear I bought was stripped of the upgrades and where converted to pay to play gear. Matches against someone that has spent $$$$ on gear is one sided and over quickly even against a great player. If you don't buy gear then change your game play to back support or duck and hide. That gets old fast. To get gear without paying takes 3-5 months. A single level up can take 4 days or more

This is a Pay to Win game. I don't like how long it takes to bulid a robot. Unless you are in the "META" you have a slim chance of winning. Far too many updates that DON'T solve the basic problems of the game, but create bigger ones instead. The economy is a joke. The playability at lower levels is fun, until you run into a "Tanker". Tanker : someone from a much higher level , who drops down to the lower ranks with maxed out bots and weapons to beat up on you.

This game has no sense of balance whatsoever. The matchmaking doesn't work right. The controls are laggy(even a year after the release of this game). It's impossible to compete in high tiers unless u spend money on this game (which isn't going to be cheap) and most importantly. THERE IS NO WAY TO COMMUNICATE WITH YOUR RANDOM TEAM IN GAME. That's right and this is "multiplayer game" with one of the most important feature missing. And lastly the game isn't very rewarding in terms of resources

Like the game, but most of the upgrades cost to much and take to long to be applied to weapons or robot. And it takes a long time to earn certain metals for upgrades, and I tried to play this game on my tablet and it kept stalling. Try to purchase some offers but won't go through, have to uninstall and reinstall before it will let me purchase. Been waiting over 24 hours for it to redownload, if I hope I don't lose all my up grades I've already purchased. Needs some work.

A good game, or at least, it was. The graphics are still excellent, and there are good options for equipping your mech, but only within a rock/paper/scissors style meta. Upgrades take FAR too long, and are limited to one at a time, and there are two currencies, with an abominable exchange rate. Be prepared for shady marketing, and microtransactions galore. And matchmaking is broken, so prepare to get stomped. A lot. If you're a filthy casual, you may enjoy this game. If you want a real mech game, go play Battle of Titans instead.

Overall very fun game, would recommend to play. But there are some problems. 1. The matchmaking system puts level 20s against people who have titans and pilots and strong stuff. It was really annoying and still is. 2. The game can be too pay to win. It is possible to play not pay to win and still be fine but it is much harder because as soon as you get in the game floods you with offers. Gold is also WAY too hard to get considering that some robots cost 3000+ gold. Overall good game though.

I have been playing this game for five years. When I first started playing this game. Walking War Robots was Awesome. No need to be a pay to win player. In the last three years. That's all changed. The game has gone to the trash. Horrible lag issues, hackers. The only way to advance or be competitive. Is to pay tons of cash out. It takes days if not months to level up bots. To the top tiers. Unless, You want to pay tons of cash out. I would stay away from this game.

Great game overall. I've been playing for a long time but deleted it for a couple years and just got back into it about a month and a half ago. My only complaints is the large application of the puzzle pieces. You can barely get any of the robots or weapons without spending huge amounts of time getting the puzzle pieces because its hard to get gold to buy them instead.

Pay to win, which isn't a problem. The problem is that if you don't pay for latest and best content on a monthly basis you get wrecked. This game used to be fun, and I could spend modest amounts of money to be competitive. Can't anymore, no fun being cannon fodder for whomever just bought the latest content. Game has become unplayable as a player spending modest amounts of money. Goodbye, I'm uninstalling the game.

Its WAS a good game. But now its a pay to win game. I had so much fun with this before the "pay to win" robots were added into the game. The amount of money you would have to spend to keep up with all the players that they put into this game is insane. Last time I check it was around $50 to get an OP robot with OP everything. Sure money can't win games, but I sure does help. And it leaves all the people who can't put money into this game frustrated.

This gameplay is good and all but the most of the robots and weapons are REALLY expensive which makes the game Pay-to-Win. The other thing is the matchmaking. It has poor matchmaking especially in Free-for-all. You're just a pilot from Silver 1 and then you get paired with pilots in Diamond 1 and Master 2. Then you get completely destroyed. Otherwise, the game is fun. Please lower the prices for everything and improve the matchmaking. Thanks.

Overtime this game became one of the most unfair, unbalanced, expensive pay to win games I have ever played. Was one of my favorites at first. I became very frustrated after spending hundreds of dollars on weapons and upgrades only to have them nerfed and become completely useless. Newer updates have made the game even more expensive. The winners are the people who spend the most money. It's not cool. I'm very skilled and it doesn't matter. game shows no love to free players. Its also very laggy

I originally rated it a 2-star because of the key chest thing, but I got over it and now, my issue is the pay-to-win players that are always keeping up with the meta. It's a struggle for me, I don't like to play, but the weapons, robots, abilities, and currency stuff, they're all good. I do recommend it if you are gonna use money further into the game.

This game is expensive if you want to upgrade all the time, then when you do upgrade there is always more to upgrade. I've lost interest because of this. When I really have nothing to do and want to kill some time I take my expensive bots out for a ride to blow stuff up. I wonder if the developers can give you an all out amount to get to the end? Without throwing cash into it, it will probably take years to get to the top level.

Game play fantastic, good maps and graphics (except for last update). Pay to win though :( I would give it 5 stars if it didn't have so many pop ups to pay for items, have to pay a lot to play more failry, or pay obscene amount to compete on a top level. The ingame currencies for upfrades also way too expensive. Guaranteedto have to pay at some point if want to keep enjoying the game. Then will find another way to make you pay. The new update makes it seem very cartoonist. Colours too vibrant.

The game itself is awesome. I loved the game until the end of November 2018. They made so many changes that they are practically forcing people to spend real money. When i first started it was nice and easy to upgrade and earn lots of silver , gold was always hard to get. Now all the new robots and weapons and workshop stuff is brutal trying to get silver and gold both. Gameplay has always been great but having to spend real money to play a damn game daily is ludicrous. FAREWELL WAR ROBOTS

Lots of fun and great competitive game - 2017 me... 3 years later after a small break...this game is nearly exclusively pay to win. If you want to grind out a decent hangar and not pay hundreds of dollars, then this isn't your game. After taking a break from the game for about a year...I came back to have a non stop barrage of overpowered bots, overpowered titans and weapons that cost over $100! By the time I earn the resources to buy them a new series of weapons will make them obsolete.

They changed the game about 3 months ago, were upgrades went from hours to days. New robots with 4 weapons could take 8 months to fully upgrade. Playing against players that have everything fully upgraded before the change had a big advantage. I was playing about 2 hours a day, but go frustrated by going 10 games in a row against clans were the match lasted less than 1 minute. I uninstalled game and will never play again.

I agree with alot of the reviews. It is a great game with great graphics. Also seems to be a money pit....if you let it. I wont spend money on any of these games and have learned to be the best at what I've got. you win some you lose some. I've recognized the whole give a little tactic used to get game enthusiasts to spend ridiculous amount of money. Seriously.$100 for a imaginary robot...on a mobile device.

The game is quite decent i like how it looks and plays. however i can barley play it at times due to all the lag and slow movements. Also the game is way too difficult in the beginning due to the fact that the enemy you're facing has way better guns and higher level robots. And of course just like all other mobile games, the game is filled with ads, so many ads in a matter fact that half of your experience with the game is you watching the same ad just over and over.

For a short while, the game feels great. Great competitive atmosphere where skill and teamwork is a large part of each match. But quickly turns to pay to win. Where you are suddenly killed by only a couple shots? A single player dominating the entire enemy team? You have to pay to keep up with everyone else. Also... ADS TO GAIN SMALL REWARDS.

this game has a good thing going for it, but there are a lot of things to talk about. Pros: this game has a ton of variety with weapons and robots, something a lot of people like. It also has a decent multiplayer experience and gets updated regularly. Cons: this game is heavy on pay to win. this game definitely has a "meta" in it. people who dont pay and grind for it have to wait approximately 28 days (assuming you have all 6 workshop slots and about 48,720,000 silver) to get it,a bit grindy imo

Moneypit!!!The problem is the in app purchases. Its complex w multiple types of currencies. The worst is that even when you buy currency, you can't buy the good robots or items, its a lottery system. Yes, you spend your money for the chance to win an item! You spend money on an abusive lottery system that keeps giving you repeated items. Also no matter how much you spend you will always have to spend more to be competitive because as soon as you're doing well they bump you to a harder category.

I am irritated by the game constantly not recognising that I have watched an advert. happens too many times. AND it always happens AFTER you watch the video, not before. one star for wasting my time. 29Oct2020 Problem persists, but less often. I admit I spend (too much money) in the game - just to be able to marginally enjoy myself ingame. I have "grinded" my way up the ranks, and my most advanced mech is barely Mk2. At my current level, it means a quick death too often.

Really good incentive and level matching at beginning of the game. So your never outmatched. But at later levels , there is a huge different between players who pay for everything and those that dont. Typical game of dish out the most DPS (damage per second) but with so many purchase options , this ends up being a pay to play unless you want to get killed over and over and over. Once you hit level 24ish, you cant compete with identical players whom pay for everything. gets boring :/

Oh Pixonic. How far you have fallen. I remember when this used to be the best damn game on mobile. It was simple, you had a good selection of a bunch of robots, all super unique, all having their strengths and weaknesses. Games were usually fair, and it was FUN. Now there are too many robots to choose, not one of them is unique anymore. Whatever ability you have can be countered, rendering it useless. The new currencies are ridiculous. There are just too many things that changed for the worse.

The game is great but it's just the system in which people get put in matches together sucks. I only have 3 weak robots that cost under 1m silver, and my enemies have extremely powerful robots with very expensive weapons. Instead of that, i would much rather be playing with people my level, or from 1 to 3 levels lower/higher than mine. It just sucks being new and going against someone who has played for months. I know you need money, but I'm definitely not giving you any if you don't fix this

Game is super buggy lately take minutes to start and get hung up on just about every add. This game is addictively fun. Buying and upgrading robots and weapon systems is great, but you NEED to buy gold to get the better upgrades. Could literally cost hundreds of real dollars. If I'm going to spend that amount of money it will be on PC or console not on a phone game. I would rather pay $5.99 for a full feature game with earned unlocks. BT controller support isn't working well either

This game in my opinion is great. Although there are a lot ads for me i still enjoy it. The gameplay is also good. Although whenever I am done with a match I launches multiple deals foe me to buy. I would like it if there was a sections for them. I wish that there would be a for it to be easy to cutumise your robots like before. There looks like way to much to do than before.

Gunfire is too loud! When you're firing nonstop in this game, especially with machine guns, it gets to be deafening--please make it quieter! Also controls (aiming) could be easier to use and gameplay could be more intuitive, but graphics are excellent. I'd also like it to stop prompting me to buy stuff (that I don't want & can't afford) but good game apart from all that.

I am disappointed by the pay to win changes in the game. Graphics have been degraded. Balance is not good once you advance in leagues. The hard to get and paid equipment dominates the game so new players will be outmatched unless you spend a lot of money. All the top players have the same robots and equipment that quicky takes down everything else, even when fully upgraded. Unless you pay you cannot keep pace with the game. I am taking another break from this game and may uninstall.

Good app! The robots are special in their own way, flying or running around. The maps are great, some for sniping and others for brawling. The only things I don't like about this game (anymore) is the lags and the events. Since the Halloween 2022 event, the loot has been ridiculously bad, and the lags still we'rent fixed. But that aside, it's an amazing game! Gg Pixonic.

Game used to be very fun, but with success comes corporate greed, and thus the game becomes a pay to win money pit. Longer loading drains my patience, especially when I have perfect internet. Most of the time you get matched with robots WAY more powerful. Some players are too strong for the team to take out, as well as some hackers becoming invulnerable to opponent attacks. Fix the game so it can be great again, or let it die it the void it has fallen into.

It is fun at first, nice graphic, gameplay. but as you progress. The Pay to Win factor is too high, and not just few dollar, u need hundreds and thousands of dollar to compete with other as they kept on rolling out new bots and weapon which made your existing bots obsolete. After few years of playing, I quit the game. Graphic and physics are good but you get slaughtered by players that put their live saving in this game. Play if you are training your patience and humility

The original company behind this game sold it to another, and the latter has made the game so much more tedious. All the upgrade prices and module/bot prices are so inflammated, it makes one think if its worth the time to continue with this sort of game as what you recieve in battles is so minimal. I really loved it while it was still good, but it's gotten a bit over the top with it's pay to progress nature.

It was fun at first, but quickly became obvious that it's pay-to-win. The teleporting Scorpio robot is ONLY unlocked by paying $75, and is one of the most annoying things to fight against. On top of that the game's awful matchmaking will constantly deploy you against higher level players with much better gear. Equipment that you can buy in-game with silver tends to either be very weak even with upgrades, or exorbitantly expensive to buy with gold... or dollars. Would not recommend.

started playing 2 years ago, and the game can get addictive. However I find as time goes on the game only gets worse. the new equipment has become so powerful that without it you can't compete in the upper leagues (masters and champion). for example the new ultimate nodens titan it takes little damage from even the best items in the game. and the worst part is all of these "top" items are paid, people have told me they've spent hundreds on a single ultimate robot. Then hackers on top of all that

Let's just say this ! If you roll around alot of money in your pocket and you don't know what to spend it on , this game is " Perfect " for you !!! To upgrade bots , you'll going to need 5000 gold cash cost $14-$79 to get started on bot , then your going need to buy silver , the cost on that starts at $20 - $99 . Not including weapons/ mod/ bots/ monthly spend up on upgrades and so on. Easy $400 a week to build one good robot. Bad Game to not waste money

Used to be a great game. The gameplay was intense and I could play for hours. Back then, the best robots in the game could still be brought down by skilled pilots. Now, the game is so centered around the newest robots. Skilled pilots in silver or even gold robots are completely dominated by rookies in these new robots. I spent some money and now feel it was wasted. The game is no longer about skill but about money. I understand giving some advantage to paying players but they completely obliterate other players in the higher leagues. Also, the league system sucks. You get to a league where you are sufficiently challenged but still gaining enough victories only to be promoted to a league where you can barely get anything done.

I stopped playing this game a while ago because after putting in ~$200 in the game, I finally got fed up with it. The game itself is fun, legitimately some of the most fun I've had with a mobile game. The problem is that it gets to a point of pay to PLAY, not even pay to win. You're always going to go against other players that have bought the newest mech, titan or weapon they will absolutely crush anything you can get from f2p. Add there being a million different things to buy, and it's not fun

It's a true freemium game, a rare breed in today's world... It's fun and challenging. Worth checking out. Update*** 10/20 that is no longer the case. The games become a disappointment, pushing for money to barely scrape by. It's not the same game I got to enjoy 2 years ago. The games begin to lose players and it just doesn't have the same feel it once did.

Good game, aweful progression, even worse micro transactions. Example 1: one store offer 11,000 gold / 49.99$, 15,000 gold / 6.99 (but hidden in the far side of menus). Example 2: One "Titan" costs 1000 platinum (most difficult currency to acquire), a weapon for it costs 1000 aswell. You need to farm for months on end and hope you still love this game by the end of it. Game preys on pay-to-win/money grubbing, so it's difficult to enjoy, but the fun aspects of game makes it playable. ❤️

I use to love the game, the robots were all fun to control and the game was very playable if you couldn't spend any money, there wasn't much to complain about. Now the game has more robots, weapons, and gimmicks than the game really needs, most of which the majority of player will never get to play due to the absurd prices. What happened ?, the game use to be golden, you could spend hours just having fun and even destress as you walked, ran or jumped into the battlefield.

This is a pay to play game. Great at first but long weapon and bot purchase times and little in the way of free methods to earn upgrades you are really doomed. If you want to invest a couple years to be competitive at a mid grade level then by all means go for it . If you have loads of cash then jump right in. If you have neither then avoid this one. Don't take my word for it, check out their facebook page comments.

After continuing to play this game, it gets progressively less fun the higher you climb. The transactions are expensive. People who spend money have such a clear advantage over other players that expecting to win or even have fun is unrealistic if you haven't spent $50 or more (on a mobile game). If the transactions were reasonably priced, it'd be one thing. However, I could spend less money for more fun pretty much anywhere else.

Very unbalanced play. The bots others have and go against you with, you can't buy, you have to build them and that takes time. Whats the point of going against teams that fly around, invulnerable, and you can't aim at them if your too close. VERY uncomfortable game play. I wouldn't have any problem if I could buy those bots quicker and without spending $100 just on the 1 single bot. When your starting out and everyone has a Titan, that is very unbalanced. I will find some other shooter game!

I used to love this game when I was younger just cause it had mechs. But now it's way too much. There are so many different kinds of mechs. Half of which take way too long to get without spending money. On top of that there's no real need for the parts system. Why force players to gradually unlock and individual weapon or mech when you can just make everything cost silver and make players earn mechs and weapons. Making money by selling exotic cosmetics. Like skins or pets or something.

Well, this game is really nice when you just download it and start fresh but as you progress, you find it almost impossible for you to get the weapons or robots that you want. You either have to pay real cash (which is just too ridiculously high) or keep on playing the game for a really long time and spend all the currency you've earned in that really long time on just a single weapon/robot.

Gameplay is great, good robots and weapons, but there's too many different currencies to buy weapons with, and unless you spend money you can forget about getting any of the really good robots and weapons. The updates always tell you there's new robots and weapons but what they don't tell you is it's nearly impossible to get without spening money. And opening supply crates are rigged to where you always get cheap stuff. Good game, terrible service to players who don't want to spend actual money.

Played in 2017, and it was quite fun. Playing it years later, in 2023 is quite different! Very much a P2W game now. You can still play the game and enjoy it, not paying anything. Just know that it'll be a grind just like any other game. Many hours will go into saving money and gold and microchips, etc, in order to upgrade a weapon, robot, pilot, or something. There'll be chances to win free stuff with raffles at the end of every season. I played for years for free like this.

This used to be a great game. In the past you could build up a line up of Robots and weapons within a few months and play at the top tier for free. But now it would take around 3 years to achieve that without paying any real money. The developers are constantly trying to steer players into forking out real cash. Every so often they will throw you a bone and then take it away. They take care of their paying customers by allowing them to use their best content to match up against you and achieve top scores and rewards. Non payers are used as cannon fodder. The game is based on 'rock, paper, be a vounterscissors philosophy. So there will always be a counter to new content. If you want a free fun game.........DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME ON THIS ONE.MANY OF US ALREADY HAVE.

The game match making has been fixed somewhat. If you are in a lower League with not many or no premium weaponry or robots at all, you can find leveled matches that are fair and fun. Hopefully the game developers will make the weapons and robots more available to players who can't afford the premium items. (Edit: Thanks for the feedback! I will do that right away and address my concerns for the game.)

This game WAS really fun. Before all these different currency you now have, it was easier to save up for the bots you want and weapons. It was a fun grind. Now there are too many microtransactions that you NEED to buy or you just won't have an edge in the game at all! Some of those transactions costs an arm and leg for being a mobile game. I can buy MW2 twice and still spend less money than 1 of their new bots!

Now, I love this game. There is so much about it which I really enjoy including the robots, updates and mechanics. However, I have been playing this game for a VERY Long time (years).. And it has become purely Pay to Win. Seriously, I have grinded this game and have managed to get a couple of cool bots but there is SO SO much that i can't unlock and never will be able to because the price of the robots and weapons is crazy! I feel like there is no real reward for loyalty.

This game used to be very fun to play. The different armaments you could outfit your robots with for different playing styles. I even purchased a few skins because I thought they were cool. I've been playing this game for over 2+ years now. Sadly, this game has gone to a pay-to-play platform. There is no strategy if you have the willingness to spend money in this game. Even loading the game up you are blasted with 6-7 different screens to get you to buy mods or weapons. I will be deleting this

STAY AWAY I've played this game off and on for over 6 years. Gameplay is fast paced and exciting. This used to be a five star game, but sadly in the last couple years, this game has become very much "pay to win" with changes made to rewards and upgrade costs. They tend to nerf old equipment and introduce new overpowered equipment which can be very frustrating given how long it takes to level your bots and weapons. It's impossible to earn significant amounts of resources just by playing the game.

The game is great. The graphics are phenomenal. But the gameplay plays more for the people who are high levels. If you just starting out, Good luck getting off the ground. Hope your rich, cause that the only way your gonna level up in the beginning. Gameplay is fun, but ridiculously challenging. Anything and everything is costly and the more you spend, the slower it is to get upgraded. Bring your millions!! Dont try to contact the makers of the game to complain, your 1 of 1000's that do, so tough tots for you!

Get rid of the components system and bring back the old system. I'm not paying 1mil + just to buy one weapon.Pixonic could care less about their players, everything costs an arm and a leg, and there is absolutely no chance of winning what you want from chests. Pixonic has rigged the system. Other than that, the gameplay and graphics are okay.

I do enjoy this game quite a bit, however, over the last few months game play has suffered do to serious lag time and freezing up...basically leaving your robot dead in the water just waiting to be obliterated by the enemy. I will say, when the game play is smooth and uninterupted, this game can be addictive but lately its been more frustrating than fun to play.

The game was so good a few years back and now the game is so rigged, it's pay to win, there's this titan that can kill 10 robots before its dead, and mostly a lot of players have it. And whenever you come back from a battle or just opening the app, so many deals will pop up and you'll keep having to close it, it's so annoying. It's hard to get new robots that are good enough to defeat pay to win players. You start off weak but somehow there are strong robots in the enemy team.

Though this game has very good graphics and is quite easy to learn, it is definitely p2w. Matchmaking could use a rework due to the fact that lots of players with low level equipment fight very high leveled opponents. Another issue is that it is very hard to get good equipment for f2p players like me and so I think that good equipment should be easier to obtain. Overall, the game is pretty fun with cool robots, weapons, modes and maps and I think it would be better if these issues were fixed.

It's pay to play. You can spend money and link up with friends and play in squads, but every new weapon or robot has a "bug" , that goes unfixed til the next robot or weapon comes out. This "bug" will allow you to have an unfair advantage in battle. Ex) new robot can shoot through walls. Fixed when new moneymaking purchases come out. It's a cash grab. Still fun though if you can spare the extra $

I would have loved to give a 5 star, but if you want the good robots & weapons to have an advantage, you'll need to spend your hard earned cash. Also if you ever run into problems in the game, customer service isn't great at assisting you AT ALL! But apart from that, if you like robots & shooting, then it's a pretty decent game.

Been playing for over two years now. This game is bitter sweet. It is expensive, so be ready to spend alot of your cash if you want to be competitive. The gameplay itself is fun, and very funny sometimes. The gameplay was hanging up alot but its slowly getting better. You'll find that they are constantly coming up with new robots and weapons and extra pilots...alot of it is to keep you spending more and more. One month you can be on top with the best bot, next month they've downgraded it

It's a good game but there are a few basic issues. First, for players who do not do anything in the game or commit suicide, there is no way to punish them. My suggestion is to punish them in front of the opponent's name. Secondly, About robots that do not have any weapon on their defensive shield for a certain period, you should note that in your robots you have set several parameters of power and the number of weapons, speed and time of their special shields simultaneously.

A company that listens to its users, somewhat. Excellent integration of ads. Not to mention graphics and game play. However, recent updates have taken a leap backwards. Discouraging many long standing players from continued patronage. I have been playing since there was only three bots to choose from, it would behoove Pixonic to look at what they were doing right when they were #3 in top grossing. UD, new privacy policy is on par with facebook. No thanks, bye felicia

Got to level 29 without paying a penny. What's it like? Well, terrible to be honest. Ridiculous team balancing combined with terrible pay to win elements makes this a terrible game for anyone who doesn't want to spend anything but a fortune. About 1 in 7 matches feels balanced. Little to no individual skill is required in game beyond picking your combination of weapons, which takes ages to get and you have to upgrade the same weapon on every robot which is silly. Should be called "Wallet Wars".

Fun game, love the graphics. My only complaints are items costs WAY to much silver, and gold. Takes way to much time to upgrade and there is absolutely NO way that I am paying your ridiculous high prices with real money. Until prices are dropped and not as high as my phone bill, I will continue to play to earn my robots, gold, and silver. I will never spend real money until prices are dropped significantly.

Favoritism goes to those who pay, and I mean PAY$! If you've been playing this game for a while like I have you would agree. In this game you can look at the stats and robots your opponents have. Now if you look at how long it takes for you to be able to upgrade anything you will see it cost a ton of money and not to mention several days for any upgrade or purchase for that matter. If you dont care about being destroyed all the time and waiting mayyyyybe 6 months to have a decent robot with decent weapons at a decent level, than yeah this is the game for you. I've had this game for over a year and at first I did invest money(about 20 bucks) bc I was addicted to it, but at that time they didn't have the robots they have now. When you have invested so much time and are now heavily invested in the robots that you've worked hard to get then you see all these players with new guns and robots you'll be frustrated to. This company needs to reward the old players and make them feel appreciated for their dedication instead of just making it about people who pay only.

I'm having fun playing the game. Not sure I want to pay for it yet, but I'm killing time blowing up robots. Edit: 4 stars to two stars. The oaywall is stupid. Maybe I just didn't spend my money correctly. Lol Besides that, I've played othe mech combat games on pc and there's strategy involved. Tactics are considered. In this game there are so many factors that by the tactics and strategy are useless. It just becomes a matter of how much money you've put it. It's fun until it's not.

A couple years ago I gave this 5 stars. I'm lowering it to 3 since this game has become so unbalanced. This game should just be called "Dragons vs. Pantheon Robots" since they are the two classes that totally dominate the field, pretty much obliterating everything else. What was once a great game with geat graphics, strategy, and didn't require tons of real cash to succeed has changed significantly and now does require regular pay out of cash to survive.

You end up with hundreds of pilots with zero organization. No search feature. It's very hard to sell them to clear your inventory of the ones you don't want. When you get a new pilot you do want, it's almost impossible to find them. It doesn't even put them at the front or the beginning. It just randomly places them... And that's just one of many issues. The gameplay is fun but the developers focus on milking whales over improving the game. It keeps getting worse and worse.

Very good game, no need to be active all the time, its a great pick up and play game. It's well balanced in my option and things that are over powered do get changed. This game is a long term game as it will take a year for the none paying player to get in the top tier area. However, It's not a pay to play game and I do love that about it. For new players I would recommend planning your upgrades, or you will waist to much time on upgrading poor weapons/robots that you won't use in higher ranks.

This game is ok. But it has quite some issues. One issue is that the game is a pay to win. Another issue is that you get way too little components from the workshop. Also everything in the shop is overpriced. So are the robots purchased with in game currency. Items purchased with gold are EXTREMLY overpriced. Also to get a good robot with real money it's around 35 dollars. I personally dont like this game once I got into the bigger robots. Never seen a game with such a pay to win aspect.

This has gone from the best mobile game to the worst. I've been playing this game some years now. I've never put any big money in the game, but have been able to play and have fun anyways. But now there's just to many robots and weapons that I never will be able to get. My weapons are around lvl 9—10 since upgrading them further would require something like 10h of grinding pr lvl pr weapon. The straw that broke the camels back, was when they raised the cost of re-training and upgrading pilots.

Really cool game, I spend hours on it... the only problem is the "pay to win" you can't compete against some other players who definitely spend loads of money and some times is just frustrating. It will take you months to upgrade a robot plus weapons where someone can come and spend 20€ and thats it... Edit: A few months after this review I came to the conclusion that you guys are making it worse!!! It's basically impossible to play against the pay to win players!!!

Was enjoying the game play initially, good idea / concept, but there's plenty of improvements to be made. Robots are just too slow. Robots can't be modified properly, only light weapons can go on some robots that would otherwise be worth using if you could mount other sized guns. Too many pop ups for spend packages when you open the game, put them in the game home screen like everyone else. Interface in garage would be too confusing for players new to gaming. Some maps have far to many obstacles

This game has gotten worse and worse over time. Pixonic seem to go out of their way to make you spend money, which is understandable. However this is now getting out of control and starting to ruin the experience. They seem to have adopted a strategy of consistenly bringing out more and more powerful robots and weapons to the point where if you want to stay competitive and win, you have to acquire these. Once enough players buy these, Pixonic then announce that these are too powerful and then nerf the power of these and bring out new and even more powerful weapons and robots and the cycle continues again and again. Over time all you end up with a full hanger of obsolete and useless robots if you don't keep spending. Stay away from this game if you don't want to be continuously wasting time and money on something that will very soon become obsolete. It gets old and boring very quickly.

I have changed my 4 star review to a 1 star one. This game used to be great, it had customizable mechas, tons of them too, it was fairly balanced and overall a fun experience. The game was pretty rewarding to grind as well! But. Not anymore. It's a pay to win hellhole now. Going f2p is literally impossible because someone who paid for weapons could mount it on the default robot and melt your health away even when you're playing on something that would've taken hundreds of hours to grind.

There is definetely a point in the progression of this game where 'pay-to-play' interupts all aspects of gameplay. It can be ignored for a while but it's hard not to feel left behind all the new nonsense Pixonic keeps promoting. I'd say to those considering giving it a try: go for it but remember, this game has no end game. No final boss to be beaten. The way to win/beat this game is simple: Play as long as you can enjoy it without spending then uninstall. NO IN APP PURCHASES! Trust me

Yet another good, solid game ruined by an insane business model. After a few days play it became clear I was at a level where my opponents had all spent big, so I looked into buying better guns. To buy the gold to purchase one gun would cost me £50. The graphics are fine, the gameplay is enjoyable but, once you pass level 20, if you're not dropping Hearthstone pro amounts of cash, you're just fodder for the "whales" who are.

This is a fun game, yes it is pay to play essentially but if you play awhile, you'll get to know where to spend money and where not too. It doesn't take much. What I don't like is when you have 2 accounts, 1 current, 1 past and the game pushes a notification to upload the old account every time you log in. I accidentally clicked it and now I can't get back to my active account. Fix this please!!

The game is great. I have been playing since 2018 now and are still playing on PC nowadays. However, as the game has progressed, it has become more pay to win as more stuff has been added. The game has now become unplayable due to lags/bugs purely because pixonic have packed the game so full of features the game just can't run on mobile devices due to everything that has to be calculated. Also the matchmaking is completely screwed. Fix this! Only get this game if you have money to spare. Alot.

While this is a truly excellent PVP combat game, and there is enough depth and durability to it to keep you entertained for many hours, it is very much pay to win. You can go the slow route of building up your robots over many hours of play, but you will never be as good as players who pay for upgrades. The game is dominated by people who have spent a lot of money on their robots. If you don't mind losing a lot, then a good game for non paying players.

The game itself if good. The problem is the matchmaking, after about level 15 it's like trying to compete in an F1 race with a shopping cart. The game becomes literally unplayable without spending money because you're matched up vs robots that delete you in seconds while you cannot even scratch them. It was really promising, but unless you're willing and able to throw money at it to be able to play, I suggest you spend your time elsewhere.

Even back then, this game was pay to win, but it was nothing like this. In the beginning, there weren't that many robots considering how many there are today, the workshop was actually useful since it could get you the best weapons, meaning you could actually get over the p2w curve and have some real fun. Now, not even rhe dedicated spenders can win, the "diversity" ruins the fun, there are more currencies to scam us, the workshop is useless, weapons in the new workshop much are harder to get.

This game at one point was fair, balanced, and fun. Over the years it got more and more money hungry, all the way to the point that even p2w players couldnt have fun. Nano-tech used to be in the game, but they took that out and made all those gold items. You can't even get certain robots without having puzzle pieces first which are stupidly expensive I might add. Gold is a rare currency and obtained in small amounts and they expect you to be able to waste it all just for one decent item.

changed my mind over the game after coming back from about a year of not playing it. The game is extremely pay to win now and old weapons and robots are severely outdated and cannot keep up with the new ones they keep releasing. Almost everything is locked behind currencies u can obtain only thru spending, and this is even more prevalent in high ranks. I really feel the dev team can do something about it, tho it might need a big rework on the game itself.

I generally like this game, but there's really no way to get ahead. The match making system is incredibly inconsistent. There are times where the teams are evenly match and you get a good battle - and you feel energized even in defeat. There are times when your robots (or a team member's) completely outclass the opponents' and its just a walk in the park ... very little satisfaction. But most of the time you walk out and are completely obliterated by some whale. And this is what kills the game.

It's a fun game. But it's your typical 'play to win'. Sure, it's easy at first when you're playing against other noobs. But as you progress in levels, you get uneveningly matched up. There are some games where I can't even take a step without getting hammered and instantly dying. And how do you even the odds? You buy better weapons and mechs with REAL money, which I did for a while. But it's never ending and the matches get harder. You can NEVER win. Greedy and disappointing.

This game is honestly really fun, but my biggest complaint is how hard it is to play normally without using money. I can spend weeks upgrading my weapons and they do so little damage, to the people who spend money on the game. The game would be much more funner if the time and effort that I put in the game, actually mattered. Everything else is great though.

The controls are nice, interface is good, the game itself is pretty fun. But it's completely polluted with microtransactions. If you had just asked me for $5 up front I'd be glad to pay it, even $10, it's obviously a good game, but being required to constantly pump more and more money into it just to progress through the game is atrocious. Was this game written by former EA peeps??

It's still too much "pay to win" aspects. If u wanna make it like that, u should make the matchmaking equal to those players who are still in the beginning and lose all the time because fighting much stronger enemies and weapons. The matchmaking should be more balanced with weapon level and robots level or classes. Put rank mode so beginners can play with beginners too, like people who just started to play. And give more of the free stuff and decrease or remove the time to upgrade anything.

I've gone in and out of playing this game a lot. The look of the game and concept are great. However, the amount of in-game currency you make from just playing is not enough to sustain the amount of upgrades and replacements you need to be competitive. Eventually it forces you to quite or make a purchase cause you can't keep up. Even after level 3, you can see one player who just mops the floor with everyone. GAME DEVS, if your reading, please make it more balanced.

This game needs a better matchmaking system for sure, it makes is so hard for new players to do anything. I have a level 9 robot with 4 level 8 guns on it but I still absolutely destroyed, and its my only good robot. It's a great game, but it's just annoying when dealing with pay to win players or players that have way more experience playing. and please shorten the upgrade time, no one wants to wait for 3 days for an upgrade that makes almost no difference.

It can be fun, but has a lot of issues. Tons of adds, and horrible matchmaking. Half the time you play, you will be matched with people who can blow up your robot in 3 seconds, meanwhile your weapons can only tickle them. The game heavily insentivises you to spend money, otherwise you will not be able to compete. Pay to win players will destroy you with ease. That being said, when you are put into an even match, the game is very satisfying.

It could be so much better. In game graphics are great. But, everything else is meh. The menus look like comparable games from a few years ago. You cannot communicate with teammates in game. The HUD is extremely basic. Game play is quiet and slow. I wanted to love this but there are just such better multi-player combat games out there.

I'm editing my review down from 5 to 1 star. I have been a part of this game almost from it's very beginning, I have also spent alot of money on this game, more than I wish to admit. My friends played as did my wife. My bots were close to top of the line, then comes along those damn puzzle pieces and all of these other robots that made my bots a joke and what's the only way around that....well buy more, spend more, so in the next couple of upgrades your new bots are worthless, I'm out!!!

there is no strategy anymore if you have lots of money to spend on the game, you can dominant the other players . if you don't have lots of money to spend, you should look for another game. the black market only gives junk. The graphics are very good. it would be a good game if it. wasn't so expensive to get good robots or better weapons.

I've played this game for a while and I can tell you, It's a very expensive and unfair game. If you are not willing to spend money upgrading robots this game is not for you. I don't recommend it. Everytime there's an update new robots and weapons come out and the ones you upgraded are useless. You have to start all over again. All the money, time energy and effort are lost. You fight people with way better upgraded robots and it's very rare to win battles. Idk why they have 4 stars.

My previous rating was a four out of five. Now it's three. I've played this game for several years, and by far the early one were better. Now, with the new updates, there are totally overpowered bots and weapons, and it's basically become a pay to win game. I kinda regret spending money on this game, especially on gold, because it's so hard to get, so easy to spend, and so expensive to buy. So, please turn it around Pixonic.

Game play is intense and can be addicting. The pay wall is ridiculous, though. The more advanced weapons and bots can cost literally $100 each or take months to unlock. Unless you plan to drop your entire life savings for some robots on a phone game, just play casually and expect to lose to pay-to-win players. Extremely unbalanced weapon system as well.

I've played this game for over 3 years now. A competitive hangar isn't obtainable without dropping money. Pixonic will make changes to keep sucking money from their player base, and it's impossible to keep up. A robot alone takes 2 months to upgrade. Wouldn't recommend. A good hangar will cost more than an Xbox and flat screen tv. Far better games on the market.

This is a fun game. It's a simplistic arcade mech game that is hard 2 find even on a pc. When just starting the experience isn't super hard and doesn't require endless matches to acquire resources in order to advance. Later however in order to get most of the better mechs or wepons you will either spend a lot of time or money. The MAJOR ISSUES is the lootbox mechanics. There's clear evidence that this game HAS GAMBLING MECHANICS BUILT IN!!!!

I played this game since it's launch. Incredible game from day one. Back around 2020 it increasingly became a pay-to-win game. The begining is not. But as you advance it is a shameless pay to win. You save up a currency, and they come out with a new currency that you need for all the latest robots, etc. Always dangling the carrot. At the end of 2021 I did and exoeriment. I played often and even spent over $500 over the course of 2 months. This kept me competitive- until I stopped paying.

I love this and play as much as I can. "Updated" I used to play this game all the time and loved it. Looks great and controls very well. I recently tried playing again, and see that It's turned into a heavy pay to win. I had some pretty good mechs, but I keep being hit with, I dont know what. And can barely do any damage against these super mechs. And now, apparently, bullets can go around walls. I get destroyed before I can get into the fight most of the time. Not very fun anymore.

Pathetic. When you log in, you get spammed by dozens of ads for expensive in game purchases. Some if you try to click past stop the app and produce a 'are you sure' screen, forcing people to look at the offer. If you never pay like me, the algorithm forces you into unwinnable battles in a bid to get you to spend. If you start quitting such battles you get severely punished and simply cannot play! The microchips and new auto deleting of turrets is simple theft. I will NEVER play this game again.

I usually dont write reviews but this game has really gone downhill. The first year was fun. There was even playing field. The people who paid money had a small advantage, but still competitive, so it was fun. The past year, it has gotten really bad. New better robots every 2-3 weeks. Playing against new max robots, our team get dominated. They made upgrading robots more expensive and longer time frame. I been playing 2 years and I still havent gotten a max level robot or a max level weapon yet.

Older player from 2017-2018. Game has changed drastically over the years. Currently, to download this app takes a while, as it takes atleast 1-2GB of storage. Don't even get me started on the money packs. As soon as I open the app, it shoves 20+ money packs in my face. They are also expensive. This is obviously pay to win, but they have fixed the matchmaking a bit, so it's fun if you're determined to grind most of the time. 3/5 honest review. Would prefer the older versions of WR any day.

The game leans heavily into microtransactions to improve it's gameplay and in-game resources. The matchmaking is unbalanced too. You can be a new player, and end up with people who have more experience and higher levels, and get absolutwly nukes out of commission. It kinda sucks. I still play it though. I just wish all the in-game resources were easier to come by. It'd make it more fun. I got tired of unbalanced matches and dumped some money into the game just to narrow the gap a little bit.

The gameplay is very different from what I played in 2019. At that time, the enemies I encountered could still be considered balanced, I could still fight them even using regular robots. But when I played it again now, the game is very different. The robots that used to be strong are now unable to compete with the new robots, and obtaining a new robot takes a lot of time and money, so the fun of playing this game is gone. Perhaps my input can be slightly reduce the time when crafting.

this game is ok with it's gameplay. I liked it. however, it's difficult to upgrade your weapons the more you play. not to mention you can pay real money to rush your upgrades which most people don't want to do. it would be cool to have a vs ai game mode which can help us get materials for upgrades without having to worry about PvP and also still have fun. to summarize, it's pay to win but it's still a nice game to play if you're lucky and get a match with players that aren't rich.

MAJOR CONNECTIVITY ISSUES. Great game ... if you can connect to it. I've spoken with other players and they are having the same issues. Some maps seem to be worse than others. I'm able to play perhaps 10% of the battles I enter without dropping out. Also, the Black Market (random loot) feature which is accessible via 'keys' won or purchased in-game appears to be bugged. There are a couple of "prizes" I've won which were not subsequently credited to my account. AWESOME game otherwise.

Extremely pay to win, and the community isn't all that great. The graphics and design of the game is amazing though, although some things are a bit clunky which is normal for a mobile game. As for gameplay, it is not that fun ti be honest. Despite the many "balances" the devs have made, they continue to push out more and more ungodly overpowered things that just makes the game unfun, and take out any strategy, forcing you to resort to a "rush in and probably die" tactic.

Gameplay is good. Graphics are also good. My only real problem with this game are the upgrades and the production of components take too LONG to complete. The other problem I have with this game is the match making. Players should be matched against other players according to their overall rating and rank, not just randomly picked. Thus ending up in games where lower skilled players with fewer robots and weaker equipment get matched against far stronger opponents.

Used to be 5 but I couldn't in good conscience leave it as such. I've been playing on and off (mostly on though) since this was called walking war robots and have been witness to this games metamorphosis. Quite a lot of the change has been good but a lot has been bad; in particular the now hyper aggressive monetization model. This game has become straight up pay 2 win, and yes you can technically earn most if not all types of currency in game but it would be a 24/7 commitment.

We need a global chat room and a way to "friend" other players. I hate to say it because I totally love this game, but it IS pay to win like everyone else is saying. Decent weapons and bots can cost 1500-5000 gold which you have to buy. Ads will give you 10-20 gold, but they're limited. It costs 5000 gold to unlock slot #5 which I seem to have lost since updates happened. Titans should only be matched with other Titans. That's frustrating! After all this though, I still enjoy the game

I do love this game however the price for this game is way too much. The earnings is too low and the timing for upgrades takes days unless you go buy gold to make the time go faster. As in today I realized this game start to freeze and takes seconds to start the game. Making me feel not want to play anymore. I hope who ever made this game fixes the problem soon.

Its got great gameplay, but its too big and bhas too many updates. I had to delete it because I dont have enough storage space for it, and you HAVE to update it to play 😑 Edit: got a new phone with better storage, so I can play it again. Only complaint now is half the robots and weapons cost premium currency, and at most you can get 5 gold every battle, if you win and come first in the team EVERY time.

This game used to be great though "premium" play alone can in theory make you pay unlimited amount of money for a game that I would gladly buy ONCE at a premium price. EDIT: As time goes by, this game is more and more expensive. Don't waste money on in-game currency, it will not make a difference for long, they nerf older stuff and overpower the new. Worse of all, the graphics and game scale were changed so that you know feel far away from the action and can barely see the shooting.

It's not MWO, but it's as close as you'll get on a phone. Challenging, fun, customization, strategy, cover fire, it's all there. Update: seems as you progress and get higher level the game simply nerfs all your hard work and / or money spent ... no surprise there I guess, just thought I'd let you know. If you play just don't level up so high you get crushed, be happy in the middle. But you'll never be tops without dropping serious cash on it all the time. Lowerd star rating from 5 to 3.

Horrible, the game used to possibly be one of if not the best mobile game out there. It was so much fun, it was a nice and simple free to play game with good balancing and gameplay. I loved how to be good or to get an edge you didnt just throw money at it. You needed skill and thinking ahead, sure you could buy stuff to get better mechs and weapons faster but it was still possible. Now its just die until youre fed up enough to spend money. If the paywall was just gone it would be 5/5

Was placed into the "Low Priority Queue" almost 3 months ago for no reason that I can discern and opened repeated tickets to Pixonic. The game is unplayable after spending $100s of dollars. In fact, even though I am being punished for an unknown issue, constant ad's still pop up and ask for more money each time I log in. It is very clear that the developer does not even care to make an appearance of fairness or good gameplay and is only driven by microtransactions. If you play, don't spend any $

I have played this game since the beginning. It was best mech game! I spent hours and hours to get the Spectre. Lots of ours spent only to have unskilled players complain it is too powerful. To have it brought down to 2 secs is unbelievable. It takes hard work to get what you want. Its one thing thing to make these things easier to aquire but when you lower the stats of items and bots for players that have been on for years, that's bad business and a reason to stop playing.

This game is the worst game I have ever played. Not the game, but the experience. The developers ruined what was an awesome game just for grabs at more money. They pay no attention to the problems in the game (hackers/lagging/etc...) and only focus in adding new unbalanced material every week that costs a bunch of money to obtain. Now they have just introduced a new currency and will be deleting equipment that cost a lot to get in the first place. I honestly hope this game fails and has to close

This game would have been great we can research the gold weapons and mechs too in the workshop. As far as I can remember, the Taran, hydra, trebuchet, etc were all claimed in the workshop at a lower components range. It would have been better if there are variety of components price range, it's an overkill to put all workshop in 10k fixed price. It leaves disadvantages to players who can't afford to pay for strong weapons just to enjoy the game, please be fair.

Just gonna lay it out clear- don't even try it. This game used to be great, but now it's become trash. You can look up the YouTubers, even they are at quitting point. I've played for years, and this is what they've released now- weapons that curve around cover and kill you in seconds, robots that if you shoot at, YOU take damage, it's just ridiculous at this point. And to add to it, their customer service is bad with purchase problems.

This game used to be fantastic, however it has essentially moved closer to a pay to play model. Too many OP weapons & bots have been introduced that are unattainable for new players. By the time a newer player that doesnt pay does get the new item & has spent the weeks required to level it up to where it is playable, the item is usually nerfed & rendered inferior by something new that Pixonic wants to drive everyone into buying. This game was fantastic, with fun events - but unfortunately greed from the game designers has tarnished the memory of what this once was. I would love to see them pull out of the nosedive they are in, but feel like they are actively trying to drive players away.

This game isn't worth a dime. I've had this game for years and it is has continued to disappoint. Leveling up once takes hours, all the robots move too slow for a 10 min round, there's only 4 game modes, you can only upgrade one item at a time and anything above level 5 could take literally 12+hrs. Shame on any dev that makes players wait days for something they already earned. If you waste my time then I'm not going to let you waste my money. Clearly not a game meant for working, paying adults.

Played one match, the control is terrible, I had an enemy right in front of me, but he was down in a canal or something and another enemy a few meters away that kept on shooting my way, I tried to lock onto the enemy that was shooting at me, but the auto aim or whatever forced my robot to shot down at the guy right in front of me. It got me so angry. Another thing, the game looks weak, 2009 graphics and colors, there's better mecha games out there.

It's just pay to win. Fun until you meet people who instakill you and your teammates. Made the mistake of downloading 10 months later, and it's even worse. My robots are now entirely obsolete, being defeated in as few as 2 or 3 hits. Most of my upgrades and the ability to heal some of my robots (which was the only thing that could let me stand a chance against pay to win players) have just vanished into thin air. I now have to "research" stuff I already had. Not wasting time on giveaways.

This game was so much better 8 years ago. Now it's filled with payment offers every single second. After a battle? Offers in your face! Do you want to make components for a new weapon? You guessed it- more offers! And don't get me started on the ads. So many ads for free stuff. And the worst part is after you get to the last ad of a chain, it'll most likely display "unavailable" for some ungodly reason. The devs nowadays want to reach their hands into your wallet and push your temper. 100% P2W.

I used to loved this game above all others, but after the arrival of the titans it has in my opinion completely destroyed the game play. I find little to no fun in playing anymore. Because of the titans. Titans are a great idea perhaps for use in certain game modes but in all modes it takes the fun out of the game. Like all the time and money spent on your robots. Was wasted.. I hope this is dealt with or corrected. But I doubt it will be.

The constant updates that take up ALOT of space only to play the game and it stalls out, disconnects, and no "updates" in site its quite annoying to play. Its almost no longer enjoyable if everytime i open the app theres a "new update". Plus when you get a chance to "play" your met with players that have the newest stuff and die within seconds. They can at least match players with the same caliber robots and not hackers. Plus its impossible to get a clan started

Fun game, if you dont have a lot of expendable income then this game may not be for you. Upgrades are extremely long unless you buy resources to speed up. Often they nerf old equipment that is years old when introducing new equipment, obviously to encourage players to spend money. Amounts of resources needed to upgrade is too high. Could be a very fun game if developers were not so greedy.

I love the game and have six different accounts on different devices and I've been playing for 6 years. But it quickly became a pay to win game with a low skill requirement. Not changing the stars, none of the devs care about this game anymore, they just want more and more money. Do not fall for the microtransactions. Edit, the devs also don't even respond personally to the reviews and they don't even try to fix the game, it's dying and it's a waste of time. Do not download.

One of the best shooter games there is. The biggest down fall of the game is your always out gunned by the red team. They have the best of weapons, or robots are maxed out in up grades. They need to make it to where u are fighting equal robots to yours. I played this game before till the controls were changed. Back to way they were. The biggest complaint for this game is trying to raise my game rating. If by chance the team I'm on wins, you get 2-10 points, if you lose they take away 10-30.

Coming from someone who's played this game for years, there's a few things to keep in mind about this game. It IS free to play, and I haven't spent a penny on the game. I dont follow the meta and I nearly one shot other bots that aren't ready for whatever I throw at them. With that being said, it's still pay to win. Anyone can easily drop as much as they want and catch up to me in a matter of months, maybe even weeks. It's only laggy if your connection sucks, and the matchmaking is solid.

Used to be the best mobile game, then it became pay to play, so i paid a lot of money to get better stuff so I could be competitive enough to enjoy the game, then when everyone had spent time and money getting the best robots and weapons, they release new ones that make ones you paid for worthless. And it just keeps going. Now they have titans and pilots just to add more ways you have to spend money to have fun. Charge 5 or 10 for the app and then get rid of in game spending.

I no longer play this game anymore. But after looking at recent YouTube videos, nothing has changed. Pretty much every update, they add some new overpowered weapon or robot forcing players to buy things to keep up with the meta. Instead of having a lock on targeting system, they should just have a normal 'you aim' system. But the pay to win aspect is disappointing as always.

Don't understand why it's so hard or you're not giving an option to transfer all progress and money spent to a New Media by just accessing the game. Cheese on rice! If you order the game again give a person a chance to put in their information and keep all their progress! Every time I order I have to start all over again that's b*******! Have an option for us to put in our number game player ID whatever. Love this game! Can't stand that you can't transfer so easy. Cheese on rice make it an optio

It is strictly a pay to win game. Don't bother with it. If you don't spend money on it, you will not be able to compete. It was fun two years ago. But, the serious lag, targeting system, the economy, the constant nerfing do not get fix. Instead, every bot and weapon gets nerfed so that more meta bots and weapons come out to get sold. The latest is a bot that teleports behind you and destroys you in seconds. It used to be a fun shooting game that has turned into an annoying magic game.

I've had to re-review this game as I used to rate it a 5/5 BUT unfortunately it has become the latest PAY TO WIN = HAVE FUN game. You cant blame the developers though! If you want HD decent quality graphics, good playability, a nice online community, scope for growth etc then somebody HAS to pay for it 🤔. If War Robots were on PS4 or XBOX it would be a no brainer, I'd buy it. Still gets a strong 3.9 from me.
