Fun game, well rounded and a real time killer! But it would be nice if the matchmaking was more fair, as i am currently level 23 and most of the enemies I'm matches with are level 26-30. Other than that, it would be nice if there were less pay to win options, as you can fully upgrade a robot in a few minutes with enough money spent and you can also buy a lot of the better robots quicker if you spend money. Besides that, the game is great!

Personally I like this game a lot, but there a few things that you change, well first if you wanna get all the good robots you need components which are next to impossible to get, and when you make components In the workshop it takes up to 3 days to make 100 out of 10000 components, and the price is very high. Before this components update people actually had decent stuff.

*This game takes me back to when I was a carefree kid in the 80s. These kind of war robots were all the rage and I used to own a toy robot which looked a lot like Destrier. I have only played for a couple of days, but it looks very promising! *(22/10/2019) The game is an endless process of acquiring the latest gear which is always overpowered compared to the second latest gear because they tweak its performance to underperform. It's a very stressful game, community and environment. (7/6/2022)

Im gonna be totally honest in the beginning the game was very fun. But after you get out of the "beginning" of the game it's impossible to win or have fun. The matches are never fair, I might be at the lowest league and I'll play against some pay to win player that's maxed out. Every match has a player like that when everyone else is on lvl 5, 6, or 7. I meet tons of offers every time I open the game. And the offers are way to expensive for me to even think about it. But it could be worse...

I've enjoyed the game for about a year and have spent about $100 over 3 platforms. If you progress you will reach a point where cash matters. You will face some serious wallet warriors. You can develop skills, tricks and knowledge; playing tactically, imaginatively and well, then lose to big money. It's crushing but if you like no-win scenarios... So the early game is more balanced and I had more fun with that. Squad play can suck, coordinated action is difficult... otherwise it's fun.

I've been playing this game for a while now and came to this conclusion: don't get into this game if you don't plan on spending money on it. It's all pay to win designed to make you just frustrated enough to want to pay for stuff but gives just enough free stuff to keep you playing. If you get something good you're just put up with more powerful enemies that kill you as fast as before without getting a chance to be better. Very little skill involved, it's just whoever has the best robot/gun.

I used to absolutely love this game, but pay to play weapons have too high damage and are unfair, and i take a few steps and my game starts to freeze up, plz make the game easier to run and less hard on the CPU. also, make this available on PC and Console, and you got yourself a great game on all platforms, and that would take care of CPU issues for the current version

I wish there were in game comms, but I appreciate that there aren't any at the same time. Purists mindset vs teamwork. A great game, constantly improving, and working on balance. Unfortunately, there has been a growth of very overt money grabbing to the tune of events, gambling, and lottery. There has become an upper class of elite tier players who buy their way up instead of earning through skill.

I definitely love the improvements and the developments made by this game after a few years. However, the point of intense grinding part of this game is quite understandable, the problem sometimes is the team comp, where sometimes there is a large gap on players, more specifically, armaments. That is the only thing I can think of as a suggestion. Also can I ask for the incoming version to buff the falcon for having 3 passive modules instead of 2, because falcon is a very good robot to pilot.

Guys, the game is good, entertaining, but there is a big issue, since it is multiplayer game. There are exploits that allow players (hackers) to gain 3x 4x the max speed, therefore impossible to defeat. Do not waste your time to play this game. Developers don't care, it's been like this for a long time. All you get is automated response. Save your money for real deal.

This game used to be fun. It was a great piloting game where you could outsmart and outshoot others. Now it's just too much of everything. Too many robots, upgrades, paywalls... All of that was tolerable but the power imbalances and hackers make it a daily exercise in frustration. Developers have to get paid, I get that, but the gaming experience has deteriorated despite the great graphics. The game had a nice sweet spot post-pandemic where I just kept spending money but those days are gone.

I was playing from the first launch. The game is evolving and so do the players. I wish the grind aspect of the game was made to be more balanced. Buying part components, takes an impossibly long time and by the time you acquire the part, it's already obsolete and the pay to play is onto the next flavor of the month. I understand making money, but fair prices should encourage more cash flow with digital product. Just a thought.

The game has a good concept and is well made, it is a little laggy at point though. It would be a great game if it wasn't pay to win, all the developers want is money, every minutes there is a new "best offer", and the store offers normal weapon that a free to play can get but they are crappy compare to the ones a pay to win would easily obtain.

What used to be a fun game with premium equipment became a prime example of "pay to win." It's not even slight pay to win. Over the past three years I've spent 45$ on this game and still cannot keep up. The new gen bots and weapons totally outclass the old ones and cost real money to get in time before they add more new weapons and the cycle repeats. Used to enjoy, now I spend my time elseware.

NEW PLAYERS BEWARE. I've played this game over the course of a few years now. - TERRIBLE Matchmaking (been a complaint, literally for years). Check for yourself. - At the end of the day, it's pay to win (PTW). Every log on you WILL have to close out of 25 different "deals" - inventory is frustrating to deal with - The "chance coin deals" are ABYSMAL. They don't tell you the chances. - Literally not enough characters to type the issues. It's not 1 star ONLY because it has potential. PTW no mor

I've been playing this game for four years and would NOT recommend it to anyone. Pixonic has turned it into a digital rock-paper-scissors game. Teams just run at each other until they run out of robots. Noob's buy robots that drop in behind you so they don't have to actually learn how to play. Four out of six games you get fed to the whales. I've literally seen six bots surround one and unload multiple magazines into it without killing it. What a dumpster fire!

This game is all about making money. They sell super powerful robots in chests that need expensive keys to unlock. Spending loads of real cash gets you the best stuff, but they always tone it down later for "balance." They keep adding new ways to spend real money for benefits you used to get with in-game currency. Updates cost a ton, and you have to play constantly to keep up. It's not fun if you don't pay—you're just easy prey for the rich players who buy everything.

The absolute worst if you do not pay money to play this game! There's far too many problems with this game to pinpoint an exact issue. The matchmaking is atrocious! The battles are unfair! Upgrades take long! Rewards per battle are horrid! Everything is expensive! Only way to progress is to use real currency and lots of it! This game is very deceptive and has manipulation all over it. Be careful if you play this game. It's unlike anything I've ever played before.

Its a fun game but there are too many pay-to win players and free to play players dont stand a chance. Also, there isnt enough robots to be purchased with Gold/Silver. For all of the good ones, you either need to spend a lot of money or spend months gathering components. And for the latter option, by the time you have all the components, there are new god-tier robots that can completely ruin it. Pixonic, please make it easier for free to play people to get the better robots.

Last 2 updates made me definitely quit, modules and pilots were good ideas, but were introduced in a greedy way, they introduced power cells and gave people an amount so they dont complain first, many of us realized after we run off it'd be a problem, but I didnt care because its not a fun game anymore. Pilots are like a skill tree idea they introduced in 5.1, but to unlock and get abilities you want... it can't be done without money. used to buy premium and play a lot, but I'm done with this...

Do not play this game.Only the rich have fun I spent over 4k on this game, with that sort of spend you would expect to be at the top of the food chain, WRONG. The company tricks you into buying the latest weaponry and robots because of the fantastic stats at the time of purchase. Shortly after, the stats are weakened and new content is released to suck you in to open your wallet again. Nothing you buy is battle ready either, everything must be upgraded before applying in battle or its useless.

Update...I've played for a couple of years now and for the most part, it's been fun. But at this point it's become rediculous...the game constantly matches you against opponents that you cannot beat. There is no question that Pixonic is pushing people to spend lots of money to play. I've seen clan members talking about upgrades that they were going to buy when they got paid...are you kidding me...electricity or a new robot??? It just isn't fun anymore...perhaps a few bucks a month...but hundreds?

My initial review dealt with the ability to move in certain places, or lack of movement. I'm updating my review simply because if the way the game is set up. The players who pay for weapons or better bots seem to dominate the game. There's no tier system of wins or grouping according to the bots abilities. You get in a game outgunned and in many instances, outnumbered by players who know each other and tag team to beat you in supposedly free for all formats. It doesn't happen. If you plan to invest a lot of cash to upgrade your bots, then this game is for you. But on a whole, most of us want to build our team by wins, which is none existent against those who stack their teams with paid for weapons and bots. If I could give a zero rating, I would.

This game could easily be the best around but there are some serious flaws. It takes an ungodly amount of time to upgrade a weapon past the 6th level. If you have any desire to win then it's going to cost you some major 💰 out of your pockets. Or plan on this game becoming a full-time job. It takes weeks for certain items. This is not an over exaggeration people. This has to be the worst grinding game I've ever played. Once you spend all that time and silver in your workshop to finally get a weapon. You would expect to now be able to purchase that weapon, NOPE! You now need 10,000 MORE COMPONENTS again. I can't imagine paying 34.99 for a single robot and some gold. Those prices are just ridiculous and disrespectful.

This started as a great game but... 1, it is too expensive to upgrade. 2, it is pay to win big time. 3, the match ups is way too uneven. 4, take too long to level up. 5, i do not know what has happened but, the game will no longer load on my device. 6, do not believe the 5star reviews, they are all fake company paid reviews. I am deleting this app.

I've been playing this game for years now and I'm extremely disappointed with where it's come to. This game is a complete money grab. From the minute you open the game you are spammed with offers that literally take minutes to click 'x' on all of them. You can no longer earn up and buy the best weapons, it's a luck based system that will take investing money in to buy enough chests to beat the RNG. Without these weapons you can barely compete. It's trash, don't bother with it.

It's hard to keep up with all the new bots and weapons and the clan ranking system boggles the mind. But other than that the game is great and my clan rocks! 31.01.19 - More changes. Great for those willingly to invest money in the upgrade of weapons, robots and now modules. Rewards pilots were receiving are being phased out. Game advancement isn't necessarily based on the skill of the pilot, but the level of their modules, weapons and robots.

In 2016 I gave the game a 5 star review. I enjoyed the game very much. Each weapon was useful and having a combination of weapons was actually effective, compare to today, those robots now are a troll builds. Many of the weapons and robots were a challenge and fun to level up. Now you can just wait and buy it for cheap and have its level to a "mach 2 lvl 1". Tier 1 and Tier 2 robots and weapons are usless at a certain rank. So, no, its not a game I recommend now.

The ideas that this game brings to the table are very unique, the gameplay at its core is beautiful. The main problem with this game, is its blatant lack of care for free-to-play players. You need a 3 figure salary at the very least just to be able to keep up with the meta. The developers don't care about balance, robots that were once meta-defining have been so power-crept that they're just completely outclassed at this point. 1/5, sad to see such a good game fall to greedy business practices.

The game itself is quite fun, though shooting guns at a target 1000m away that you can hardly even see on a phone screen is just silly. As with many other good games, the multiplayer experience in a pay to win game is the worst unless you're interested in dumping a bunch of money into it. As a free to play gamer, don't bother; I'm uninstalling it. The push to get you to buy guns, gold, etc after every game is ridiculous; 10 or so after every game!

This game is fun and sure you can spend hours playing. Unfortunately the company behind it, well they are whale hunting. They are constantly skewing the meta in favor of their new features. You can technically earn everything in game but we are talking on a scale of YEARS. So with a current content cycle of 3 months... Buying content flat out will likely cost you thousands of dollars so, take that it for what it is. Lower end content is still lots of fun and the game has tons of potential.

Great game, always will be! I have played for seven years, but over those seven years, I've noticed some changes. While it may still be a fun game, it just isn't like it used to be. Now, every time you boot up the game, you are plagued with discounts for buying new robots and currency, and can barely get to the main game we without closing out twenty different tabs. On top of this, now servers are full of pay to win players, who make the game unnecessarily difficult and unenjoyable. Unfortunate.

Absolutely rubbish. As soon as I open I get bombarded by pay offers. All the new things are op and you have to pay. Only thing you can do to progress is workshop but it takes a few months to make one thing and by the time you've made it another more op weapon or bot is released. I Now imagine having to do workshop for 5 robots each with at least 2 weapons. That's a few years. The only way to progress is to pay. I spent years of effort to be one shot by a guy who paid. Ridiculous.

The people who spend money get too much of an advantage (eg. You need 10,000 components to get a SINGLE (actually decent) robot/weapon and you can get 20/30 per week or 100 if you invest large amounts of in-game currency (amounts that takes about an hour to grind) but you can get them instantly if you spend money).If you have a xbox(not sure about others) controller bluetoothed you can use the left stick but thats it. If you are going to add controller support, at least make it work please.

(Christmas update 2018) Finally decided to get back into the game after a brief hiatus. had to update the game again. As of most current update, the workshop is useless unless you want to wait years to put a weapon or bot together, or pay big bucks. In-game targeting is extremely frustrating, jumps around a lot. Game now completely caters to paying players. If you want to spend a ton of money, (hundreds of dollars) then this may be the game for you!

Good game. None like it out there. I've changed my review after playing for a couple weeks and $50+ into it. War Robots is a paid to win game. I've normally given on average about $50 to any one as a way to pay for the developers. And on general that amount is a good base to competitively enjoy FTP games. However, War Robots is 100% paid to win game. At the moment I've stopped playing this game as it is no longer enjoyable. It's hard to enjoy any game when you'd die at the first 5 second

Edit: The passive module update finally got me to delete the game for good, good riddance. Just to get to the main menu, I have to click through 10-25 "one-time-only" deals and offers, all 5$ at minimum. If ur good, you'll be put into higher leagues, and each time you will have more and more games be decided solely by which one or two players have the most money put into their lineup please, save yourself the frustration, do not play this game companies like you will be the death of gaming.

Update--01/23/21 It's just okay now. With the advent of newer robots came a number of imbalances. Scorpion has too much HP for its ability, those purple shields have no counter, and flame goes through everything. It does not feel like a fair game anymore. I understand that as a company they need to make money, but it's now almost impossible to keep up without paying now. It's too bad really because it used to be such a good game :(

I've played this game for over 7 years. Currently it is at it's worse state. It is no longer even pay to win but pay to pay, if you do not have the latest items it's almost impossible to compete. You have robots that can single handedly whoop and entire team along with their titans just because you pay a boat load of money for them. The game has beautiful graphics, tons of customization and fun battles, sadly ruined by its pay to play aspect, the developers have really kamikaze'd the game.

This game gets really hard after a while. Its fun and all, but you end up using the same 3 robots because it is so hard to get gold to buy better robots and more hangar slots. Its stupid how the ai you ALWAYS play with, (almost never real people) have all the best stuff in the game, with all the best robots. It is very unfair. And absurd prices too.

I'd say it's 5 star, but apparently just today it won't load the hanger. I wonder if the update has anything to do with this situation. Or it could be my restricted WiFi... Anyway, it's an amazing game, and one of the best online games I've ever played. Except for the 'Gold' weapons (or anything Gold, for that matter). Like, I get gold isn't cheap, but the pricing for it is insane. And the Free-for-all is a bit unfair for the free gamers out there. Please change that, I get scrapped within 15sec.

Game used to be fun, back when there were only two currencies. The creators have gone money hungry asf, this game is a total pay to win. I still play it bc I got some good bots before all the madness when they were easier to get. Stop being money hungry, make the game fun again please! Also, the game has gotten way too complex with modules and pilots and stuff, its too much to keep track of for me, especially for a mobile game, it gets annoying. Make a console and pc version, thats also be cool.

The game used to be really great and had a lot of potential, but the creators became really greedy as it seems just like wargaming. As soon as you reach level 15 it won't matter what robots you have or what level it is, same for the weapons, you'll simply be outmatched by robots that kill you within 10 seconds while you don't even take 25% of their Hp. If you're one of those people who like to put a lot of money into a game then this one is it. Otherwise if f2p then advised not to play this.

You can plan it if you have loads of money .... I tried to play it by spending some money.But it was not worth it. They will show very hightech robots before you pay. Once you pay you will get some low cheap robot and they will ask to pay more and more for better robots. I really wondered people really pay that much or they are just the developers itself. I don't think someone is paying that much money to play a game...it's fun.The graphics is awesome. So I still tend to play it.

Having played this game for some time, it's sad to see the game developers so sell out the game. It was a fun and well balanced game, but it's obvious as the developers made money selling overwhelming mechs and weapons, they would ignore how it actually played. Now the game is often an uncoordinated serious of flashes and bangs that might look cool (especially to first time players), but actually takes away from its enjoyability. I really feel like anyone who plays over time will notice as well.

It's pretty good so far for a mobile game. Looks good. Addictive. In-game purchases are NOT good value for money. Sometimes they may put on a good offer, but months apart. Some good giveaways for watching some live streams on YouTube, but chances of winning arent good. Upgrading robots is hard work if you don't pay. Game is top 6 grossing for a reason. They introduce new robots which make the awesome robots you were working on seem weak. Most complaints about this game center around this.

Before 2017, this game was actually enjoyable; But after 2017, to now, it is a pay-to-win game. For one, black market seems very rigged, because you'll get the same prize over, and over, and over again for the bronze or silver ones. Next, whenever new robots or weapons are released, they take a very long time to acquire via parts, or you'll have to fork-up a rediculous amount of money for a lvl one to five robot or weapon. I'll change my rate when these are fixed. Also STILL no in game music.

I have been playing for 2 years now and I have to say, the game is becoming completely pay to win. If you want to stand any chance of playing competitivly, you will be shelling out $$$ in the thousands(no joke). Bad game. Make you buy weapons, then spend cash on upgrades, then they make the weapons weaker. They do this over and over again. is getting worse and worse every time this used to be a good game, and i really enjoyed playing, i used to upgrade my robots without having to spend a penny, but now you can't. I've started playing in 2015 and had really enjoyed it. The game provided an even playing field where skill could trump purchased equipment. That is no longer the case. I believe some bean counter now has a say in each update with the goal of increasing profit. There is no longer any aspect of the game that is not directly affected by how much money you spend. #paytowin They have made some very good adjustments in game matching that take into account Robot abilities as well as player rank.

War robots is a well done game from top to bottom, albeit with a number of minor imperfections that make this a four-star game as opposed to its full potential as a 5-star game. Consider your target audience. Young tweens and teenagers cannot feasibly spend $40, $60, $80 or more on some of your in-app purchases. These are extremely overpriced and very difficult to come by if not impossible by just playing the game and leveling up naturally. Furthermore, considering the amount of gross profit you make on this game, I would highly recommend creating more boards, and offering more variety of gameplay, not just variety of robots and weapons that the majority of users will never touch. Also, consider offering a point of view from inside the robot, sitting at a control panel.

Aggressive monetization. It's pay to win and doesn't favor any actually skill. Full of people with credit cards and buying robots and more, weapons without actual skill. But when there is none of these kids in the game, which is very rare, it could be fun. You can now heal back 80% of you HP when it took your opponent a lot to bring you down that low. Certified "Fun and Engaging". The game shoves ads and in app purchases in you face you you open it. Short story it was fun, now it's pay to win.

As any other review here says it's pay to play which isn't necessarily bad. It would just be nice if it wasn't $500+ to have a team with decent microchips, support bots, hanger slots, and main bots. Or if there was a decent way to farm for them by playing a lot. One of the bigger things that upset me about this game is that the ads are so misleading, I've seen ads for co-op boss fights that don't exist, for humans running around shooting each other and hopping in mechs like it's titanfall.

Played this game 7 years ago, and man was it great. You could level up pretty consistently and get most the thing you wanted. Of course there were thing you had to buy in order for the devs to get paid, but coming back is atrocious. At least At one point you could roll for a whole weapon, now the only way to get weapons in f2p fashion is silver (which is approximately only 12/200 weapons) and rolling for it with some arbitrary currency. Pixionic, don't even try to deny that this isn't pay to win

This game recieves regular updates in which the strength of weapons and robots are constantly altered by the developer. So, when you spend money to upgrade an item, it can be weakened in the next update, effectively meaning that the developer just walked away with some of that money you just spent on your item. This game also has some indestructible bots to entice players into spending money to buy the same setup. Fun to play, but this company's business strategy is very machiavellian.

Here we go again. I have already shared my views. I have not made a purchase of anything for several months and on discord I share that thought process. Collecting resources to buy them is too difficult, complicated, and time consuming. It's too pay to win, there are lots of cheaters, and the matches are always unbalanced. Coming from a former expert league player The game is still fun, it just isn't what it used to be anymore, it takes too long to get new robots and weapons, so people often pay for them [the game also showers you with offers as soon as you open it]. For 2 years I played this game. I have enjoyed it. Now, I am editing my review. From 4-stars, down to 2-stars. The pace of new robots and weapons, has created a dominant pay-to-win class. I would ask the Developers to consider what they're are doing. Having said that, I still enjoy the game for the base desire that it satisfies. That being the desire to destroy other robots, using exotic and powerful weapons.

It's fun, but I have spent a quite a bit of hard earned money to build robots and weapons up, only to have them become antiquated and practically obsolete when new robots are released. I can't justify or rationalize spending any more money on such an unbalanced game. This pattern I noticed... Spend money for stuff which could be bought less, later in the week or month. That's a trap. I feel like the Devs are laughing at me. I'm breaking the bonds today.

Edited down from a 5 star review across the board. I used to love this game, but the stripping down of controls, increased premium currency gambling mechanics, increased lootboxes, and inclusion of multi hundred dollar expensive robots (that you can earn, 1-20 parts out of multiple thousands at a time) have cheapened and ruined what looked like a promising game for me.

HORRIBLE HORRIBLE support!!!! I worked so hard to get so far and build up my robots. Game has gotten worse by the day and I've played for years. It's really just pay to play competition. The rest of us cannot advance, cannot obtain many weapons, bots, or upgrades that are bought and used against us every game. The bought bots destroy in one shot bots you'll spend over a year to max out to be rendered obsolete in one shot by a newb who spends his big money. If you've not started this game, I recommend to not start now. Find a different game. You'll only be disappointed.

Horrible matchmaking. I quit this game a few years ago after reaching level 30 (max) due to the increasing pay-to-win bots and weapons, and it's only gotten worse. Now after a couple of hours of playing, I go up against people in matches with equipment several tiers of quality higher that should not be in my league and there's almost no way to avoid being destroyed. Would highly not recommend unless you are willing to spend a lot of money (on the order of hundreds of dollars) for good equipment.

Many opponents have the best robots, mk2 weapons, more one hangars, while they have the same rank as me and easily destroy my robot, some even in a second! And you have to hide behind buildings or teammates and play most of the game. I even got some good robots and weapons from the chest, but it doesn't work against many of them. Also, the robots move very slowly and the game has a slow rhythm to progress.If you don't want to spend money, don't install it. I uninstalled it.

Very disappointed. The game itself is good, but the matchmaking system is pure garbage. Battles become very unbalanced later on in the game. It seems like developers designed matchmaking for buyers to have their ego boost or something. I actually considered buying too, but I like fun battles not 2 minutes massacres. If teams in battles would be even, or at least close to same power then this would be a fun game for everyone. This way it gradually becomes boring. Another problem is that you can upgrade one weapon or robot only and once that's done only then you can upgrade something else. This is a huge blow. Anyway, it was fun, but I don't like unfair games, so all the best. My journey in War Robots ends after 4 days. There are other games out there which can offer players balance in battles, teams and game play.

Pay to play is the way you'll get ahead and enjoy the game. Great graphics but gameplay is based on matchmaking and results in you losing alot. Shooting mechanic was broken as well. On the up side a very responsive support team but they will do little for you. Really just a marketing tool more than game developed by true gamers: nothing else. They just want quick cash and fast downloads.

Okay, this game looks interesting but is not what it is. As I am a veteran of this game, this game basically is all about pay to win and guns. Honestly, it's fun at the start but after a long time, it's boring. The only good things are its designs and sound and visual effects. Other than that, I don't recommend you to play it.

I am editing this rating because it was a few years old when it was fun and pay to win didn't exist in the game (there were only like 20 robots in the game, most of which were relatively easy to get). -5 STARS THIS GAME HAS BECOME COMPLETELY PAY TO WIN!!!!! There's also way to much lag!!!! Also you'll lvl up gear just for them to neuter your gear a few months later. Heavy pay to win, i don't know any other game that wants your money so bad The difference between a free to play and someone who makes purchases is hilarious. You don't stand a chance. Too money-hungry to be entirely fun. Pay to play. Definitely not free to play friendly. Was fun but they just kept constantly adding more and more unneeded features, non that are helpful or for the betterment of gameplay. This game is pure pay to win, no matter how much you spend on the game. If you don't keep pumping an unreal amount of money, you will be just an npc in the game. Great game, but the developer has gotten extremely greedy. i played the game close to when it came out, it was a lot of fun at first. as time went by, the gap between paid players and free players increased and the game became less fun. i really liked the concept of the game, but the way they go about things is horrible. this update along with all the reviews of people who feel the same way has given me the strength to delete the app finally.

Best, most intuitive, and smoothest mobile shooter game mechanics, period (yes, better than CODM). Spent $100 over 3 years. Warning to new players! This game has become a straight PAY 2 WIN situation. If you have expendable income then you may like it, if not, please don't waste your time. And because the bot is so slow, anything that can outmaneuver it slightly has the upperhand. The combat is kind of slow in the start, everyone has the same 1 or 2 bots, which is to be expected. However, there are a few different kinds of "currency" to spend, one of which that I think is ridiculous is 'components'. You have to get 10,000 of them to actually get the bot or weapon. And it's only the good weapons and bits of course, you do have a factory of sorts that can produce them for you... At 100 components a cycle. They also cost Silver to purchase a cycle, and the lowest cycle for a bit named "Doc" is 2.5 hours iirc. You could spend real money to buy components. But the conversion rate is so steep. For a light bot like mender it costs 62.99 to buy all of the components to make it. I don't have to remind the Devs that this is a mobile game right? This game isn't for me, but if you have a lot of time to kill, and don't mind the grind for an eventually better Bot or weapon that you have to further poor money and time into upgrading just to match everyone elses level, this is the game for you.

I used to love this game, but recent updates simply ruined the game economy. Even though it was intended to make all content more accessible to the players, it actually made the game almost unplayable. Let's take a look at the facts: - Gold was taken out of Royale, thus it's almost impossible to get bits of it for free equipment upgrade speed-ups - Workshop 2.0 was introduced to make all content available to everyone at the cost of silver, but recently increased production times and prices made it obsolete - Upgrade costs and times were increased beyond any logic So I'll tell you how it looks like from a fresh, casual gamer's side: - I can barely afford any new equipment unless I play dozens of matches a day grinding silver - Even if I can afford it, it takes weeks if not months to upgrade, so I could compete with it - Speeding up both production and upgrade times with gold sums up at an insane amount, just do the math. No one is even going to cash in so much for that As of today, I currently see no way for a casual gamer to improve his hangar and compete in this game. Either you cash all-in with your salary for gold, or you grind 8 hours a day and still have to wait weeks for upgrades to complete. And I personally chose this game exactly because I didn't have to spend hours and hours online everyday. I liked playing 5 matches one day, and ten times that the other day. I was okay with buying some gold to buy components now and then. Now all that is changed.

At first 2-3 year this game was very interesting, because the abilities of the weapons and robots had advantages and disadvantages that made this game balanced. so player skill plays a vital role here. but lately this game has become very boring because of robots or weapons that are too strong, sometimes one robot can defeat all opponents almost without damages.

Lopsided, it starts out this way and continues to be true throughout play. The games are initially extremely easy until you level up and begin more open map play. Then it's ridiculously lopsided by the paying players and non pay players. Matches are not even and there is zero strategy involved. Just whoever pays the most for upgrades. Another one of these time sucking mindless games. Sad, it had a ton of potential.

Pixonic has driven this game into the ground. I played for 3+ years and it has steadily declined every year. Instead of fixing fundamental problems like lag, targeting, and the economy, Pixonic just keeps adding more elements to drive revenue. The game is now totally unplayable and is totally unbalanced. Only P2W players have any chance to advance.

IT IS #1 PAY FOR PLAY game on Google. Every update boosts the amount time needed to upgrade. Upgrade costs are ridiculous! Upgrade times are worse than the cost. It now takes OVER A MONTH to get a weapon or a bot. I have found that it is useles to try and keep up. Invest in xbox or playstation, much greater bang for the buck. If you have loads of money that you need to get rid of, this is your game. it use to be fun to play. I only play occasionally now. I am searching for a better game.

Been playing this game for 4 or 5 years, fell in love with the idea of lvling up mechs and weaponry with the complete focus on player vs player. The game can be fully enjoyed without having to spend any cash but money spent can certainly speed up upgrades and acquire you the best robots and weapons up front but let me tell you they aren't cheap purchases. All in all i still enjoy this game on a daily basis and will continue to do so because the game just keeps getting better and better everyday.

Installed it again because I read that fixes has been made. Heres my point of view: 145 keys got me nothing decent Gold is useless. Nothing good to buy with them. Equipment and bots still costs an arm, a leg and kidney. Who buys a $100 robot and $300 worth of equipment which is actually item? Conclusion: Same $#!+, different day. I would rather play that game in the pc where you can buy 3 robots for $20 and equipment for game bills.

Squad communication during battle needed. Microphone chat would greatly increase the game's potential, and create like minded squads. Reload button needed. Customizable button layout as well. Constantly accidentally hit the module button when it isn't needed, it would be better higher up. Gameplay is great. Season rewards are weak. The cost to buy items is ridiculous and unrealistically expensive. I would happily spend some money on this game if they offered affordable deals.

The whole thing about being in the low priority queue is a load of nothing. I've left on multiple occasions because I had to and I literally can't even find a match. I've waited 30+ minutes and still nothing, I literally can't even play the game! This devs really should just focus on actually improving the game instead of just adding more robots and weapons

Good game is a lot fun but if you don't spend money you won't get anywhere. In matchs you get put up against robots a lot stronger than you. I find you stand a chance with 3 out of 10 matchs. If you don't spend the money you will struggle. A lot of the upgrades take too long to upgrade or they cost to much to do it without spending money. A lot of the players spend money making progress is hard.

I made a new account and only use 3 bots. All of which are level 1, as I have not upgraded any bots or weapons. The game is still placing me in matched with mk3 players. I only have 3 slots open for bots and its all base level. If you dont believe me, try it out for yourselves. This is insane. Edit: So your response to matching an account with all level 1 gear is, "That is how we made it"? Ok, well that is why i uninstalled it. Playing your game is pointless.

Please add up-down control to aim better,add more game modes (like team deathmatch).Please fix the glitch where slow robots(Natasha),can't go up even the slightest upslope or do so in slow motion or how they treat low obstacles like walls and can't go over them.It would also be great if you could add special slots to robots and weapons,to add special mods(bought with gold-WP)that add attributes(lower cooldown,add ability,weapon slows down enemy,energy shield reflects amount of damage,add weapon slot).Thanks

Every time you do an update... Adding more bots more weapons... My game lags!!! I am now not even able to play because my tablet freezes up. NO!!! I am not buying a new one!!! Not to mention, within HOURS of new items released, there are the wallet warriors and hackers that have maxed out the items to their fullest. Leaving those that want to play for fun in the dirt. What used to be a fun, usually evenly matched game has become a pay to win format because of greedy developers and hackers.

This is a very good game. Although it looks very boring it can lead to heart pumping battles, relief of victory and a overall enjoyable experience. There are many rewards for ads and leveling up isn't too hard. But one thing I do not like is that if you don't use money to buy gold(or platinum) in higher ranked battles you get overpowered by people who do. There's just overall this big pay wall stopping you from getting as powerful as your enemy. But ultimately it is a very good game.

War robots is a very fun game. It has different playstyles and different gamemodes to play in. The robots even look really realistic and the artwork is good. Overall i really like the game. But the only downside is that the game is really time consuming. It takes around a year or so to get a good robots with decent weapons. If not its also very very P2W(pay to win). Its impossible to play the game wihout spending money. And the matchmaking has to be improved according to levels.

Overall gameplay is ok. But you near to add a reload button. It's so annoying when you have to manually shoot out all the ammo to reload. And the upgrade system is slow. I hope you add the option to run 2 or 3 upgrades at the same time. And one last thing. Let us make squads with different platforms. I wanna play with my friends that are on another platform...

Every month you can buy the latest greatest invincible bots and weapons if you have the cash (alot of cash). If you're trying to grow your hanger organically just by playing let me save you the suspense, it's never going to happen. Every weapon and every bots power and durability are constantly manipulated up or down to keep you spending money $$$

Used to be a fan, spent quite a bit though never enough to be top tier. Can't even play now. Latest version crashes before passing the first loading screen. All that progress and money spent is just gone now I guess. Definitely not a free to play friendly game unless you want to devote a few years to grinding as resource drops have always been a trickle. If it works for you keep that in mind.

I have been playing this game since nearly the beginning and most of time really enjoy it. If you don't want yo purchase upgrades, it does take what feels like forever to stay competitive, but it can be done. New content regularly helps keep if from being boring amd moving on. Great way to kill time.

Been playing for a long time. A good game, but not as good as it could be. The game has unfortunately become extremely pay to win, leaving it extremely challenging for casual players to keep up with the constant addition or robots and weapons that are more powerful than everything else, making it less enjoyable for your non paying player

I used to really like this game but with the more supposed upgrades the more they require you spend on the game. When I mean spend more, I'm referring roughly spending $100 us dollars to buy one robot. They have made this game unfair and extremely mismatched. If you have the pockets this game is for you. If you're on a budget like me then be prepared to stomped on by the heavy spenders who are ranked way out of your league.
A REALLY GOOD GAME! but the new robots are way too overpowered and they nearly impossible to kill even with a Titan and also make the 5th slot unlock price make it a little low IT'S 5000 GOLD!!!!!!!!

Extremely pay-to-win.. Absolutely no way to get ahead with upgrades without spending real-money! Lots and lots of real-money... And if you decide to only play for free, they have it so you'll have to watch Ads over and over just to try and speed up things but it does not matter.. You'll never win against those that put hundreds and hundreds of real-money into the game!

Very addictive. But it is becoming to much of a pay to win game. Too many instant kill robots. Before you had to think about the robot you wanted fire power or speed or durability or a combination. Now you can bolt on jumping ability, shields.. takes away from integrity of the game. The "artificial" barriers in the death match games cheapen the maps! Weapons that cost more than a robot, makes no sense, especially when you are starting out. I've never had too much of a problem with the matching

This game was great before they started reducing weapon damage or nerfing everything. If you purchase something in this game, upgrade it, spend hours of time on it, only for them to release an update making it useless. I mean geez who wouldn't want to play that kind of game. Please spend your time, spend your money, so we can make it worthless. Welcome to Pixonic. Where we love to break our players!

Great game, easy to play, hard to master... Addictive, I've been playing this game for years, and lately Plxonic seems to have decided to add kinds of fancy gadgets (for those who can afford them! ) The playability of this game has gone downhill for those not willing to hand over big ol' wads of cash. Pardon the pun here, but this ain't the only game in town.

Love the game it's a fun way to kill time. It can get a way too pricy for my tastes with the whole in game purchasing (pay to win) system because everything is $4.99 and up (everything worth buying is $29.99 and up). My only real request and complaint is I wish there was a controller mapping option in the settings so it'd be easier to use gamepads either Bluetooth or like the one I have for my Moto Z2 Force phone. Beyond that the game is fun solid and has decent graphics for a mobile game, it's one of the few mech games I've played that wasn't a complete disappointment.

The mechanics are easy to learn, and game play is quick and fun. I'd give it 5 stars if the pay to win scheme wasn't so polarizing. It can take years trying to fully level up a bot, weapons, and pilot without payments. But there arw a lot of opportunities to win stuff during events. I wish crafting was expanded to include all items in the game. Its a bit frustrating when you have a build idea and can't do it be a use you can't get the weapons.

I love this game. Some things I dislike: 1. It takes FOREVER to upgrade anything! 2. Regarding ads they offer you watch, in exchange for reducing wait times on the upgrades: it's quite common to watch the ads, and to have nothing happen. Sometimes, there pops up a notice that there are connection issues (therefore, no time reduction) AFTER you have watched the ad.

This game used to be fun when it came out. Now it's way too p2w you can buy defense bluffs, supply bluffs, attack buffs, and not to mention the aiming system is atrocious. (In order to aim at some enemies I have to look away then look back to "lock" on to that enemy. And if an enemy is shooting at you from partially behind a wall, you can only shoot at the wall with the forced center mass lock on. This game is a shadow of former self

good models. good graphics. immersive sound effects. wide selection of weapons and robot. STILL CANT PUT THE CONTROLS WHERE ITS COMFORTABLE FOR ME AFTER 4 YEARS. its exciting game and it's easy to hit the wrong button. now it's easier to hit a special button that will eventually deplete all my resources. I want to like you, but if I'm gonna play for hours I wanna be comfortable. I'll try again in 6 months.

Great game play with a surprising amount of depth and complexity. Strategy plays as much of a role in winning as firepower. Updated 4/15/20. Came back after being gone a while. Game play has degenerated into a slugfest, which was disappointing. There is still strategy, but much less so. The Hanger has become a real pain. The ads and sales have become all the game is about now, and things lag bad. It takes a 5 second wait between selections.

This game is a ton of fun, has great graphics and near endless combonations of robots and weapons. However over the past couple of years it has become pay to win. The rate at which new OP bots and weapons drop os ridiculous and the only way to get them is to drop cash and lots of it. You can still somewhat compete without spending any thing though it just takes forever to get to that level. The amount of resources and time it takes to upgrade a bot has skyrocketed over the past couple of years.

No doubt it's a exellent game. I'd have given 5 star, but couldn't. Cause there are some problems, you should fix. For example, there are some offers I can get by watch video. But most of the time those remains unavailable. It's really frustrating you know. Also it's a bit slow. Even with 4G the game in pretty slow. You should fix these to make it better

Good graphics. Good feeling of progression. Great action. Good high tech feeling. Lots to keep players coming back for a while. Edit: since my Sept 2018 review, it's almost like they have added TOO MANY robots, weapons, specialties to the game. What really needs a refresh are maps and battle types. Doing the same thing over and over, even with new stuff just gets boring. HAVING SERIOUS CONNECTIVITY/ LAG ISSUES on all devices. Massive lag, sometimes just crash to desktop. Not stable anymore.

Good points - easy to learn. At low level it is fun to play, quick to upgrade and easy to lose hours playing, variable maps / game types keeps things interesting Bad points - upgrading one thing at a time is tedious (especially with high levels taking 5 days to finish), match making is mostly ok...ish. Lots, I mean LOTS of pop ups trying to get you to spend money gets annoying rapidly. Balance is way off, use the latest, greatest weapon or your destined to lose....alot

Once upon a time, this was a fantastic game, probably the single best mutliplayer mobile game I've played. Simple mechanics, plenty of ways to customize builds, and actual skill usually outperformed higher levels or weapons. Now? I can't even open it without having to say no to four different popups for buying gold or tokens, and sure, you could ONE DAY get that cool robot they just introduced, but by the time you get it, they have 15 more that are twice as strong. If you can't pay, don't play.

Don't get me wrong the game itself is a lot of fun to play. I've spent lots of my time playing it and I enjoyed it. With that being said pixonic is ripping players off with ridiculous updates encouraging us to spend more money. The only real way to get gold in the game is to buy it. Getting silver either requires lots of your time or a paid subscription that cuts that time in half. Upgrading your robots and weapons takes a ridiculous amount of time and they're only increasing upgrade time and costs as time goes on. The makers of this game are very greedy and are ruining this free game by basically making it pay to win. I've noticed this more and more as I progressed and I've had enough.

Great game!!! So many different robots and everything makes it so intriguing. Only one downfall, ordering components take too long. Overall definitely should be installed. To get 5 stars, PIXONIC need to fix one bug in the game. On the custom game if you invite by ID it doesn't work, fix that and get 5 stars. I do have one suggestion that would be cool. When you buy stuff with gold you should be able to sell it for the same currency because if you buy something with gold you can't sell it for gold which is quite annoying so you must choose wisely and can't really experiment with things.

1) This is the closest I've seen to BattleTech in app form; thank you! 2) I've played for a couple years and only spent like $3, and I hold my own just fine; even slowly climb ranks. 3) The match making could use a small tweak, but I like the challenge; its the only way to improve your skills. 4) Please make gold a LITTLE easier to earn, and move the active module button a little farther from the weapons button. I keep accidentally hitting it; fat thumbs. 6) Otherwise, a well made game!

Update: It's even worse after the latest additions to the game. It is now totally unbalanced in favor of the pay to win players. Try Battle of Titans or Robot Warfare. If you're not willing to spend real money to level up, don't bother with this game. It's too heavily rigged for the players spending $$$. It takes a ridiculous amount of gold to get anything useful. You're just cannon fodder for the pay to win guys, making it even easier for them to upgrade. The matchmaking is unbalanced.

This game used to be amazing. But after many, many major updated, it became a new game entirely. It used to have two forms of currency, now they have at least 5. It was always fun when they added new bots, maps, and game modes, but they added to many features (most of which was just to make them money) and it made the game almost unplayable. The game originally had steady progression and a play your way style, now there is only spending hundreds of dollars to get the best bots and weapons.

I used to love this game. But after taking some time away, the pay to win economy and power creep had escalated to new heights. All sorts of bots, with crazy new abilities, and getting the components for a bot like the Hover took over a month, and weapons were even worse. I started a battle, and my entire hangar was atomized within minutes. I haven't played since. I can't enjoy myself when it's impossible to be on a competitive level without sinking hundreds of hours or dollars into the game.

Returning Player I decided to give this one another shot after a rather long break. Most of my experience with the game was with it before there were Titans or workshop research opportunities. The game has added content in new maps, lots of new robots, and new weapons since I started playing. It can be a bit grindy to upgrade or save for newer bots but that's ok in a free title. The one thing that really continues to bother me is the targeting system. I can't easily target enemies.

Over all it's a fun game. Reminds me of the old days playing mech warrior on my old 486. There are issues with the controls. They sometimes stop working when you are walking and shooting. Also there seem to be issues with the game reloading during battles. They really need to fix the matching for battles. People are doing multiple suicide missions like crazy to get their rating down to where they have a huge advantage.

Like many others, I found this game fun at first. Recently however it is very much weighted towards the pay to play model. Think squads of overpowered flying bots that you can't lock onto or even get near when they are on the ground. Also, just when you think you have got nicely powered up then some newer, better weapons come along and you are back to square one. For a time killing app it is ok, but if you really want to progress you're going to have to stump up some serious moolah.

One of the main things that comes to mind when I play is "Man, I sure do wish I could play a round without getting pwned. I'd need to buy gold, or some 'special' deal though, and even if I do it'll let me keep up with other players for about 2 rounds." Yeah sure, I enjoy the actual battles, which feel slow but powerful, but they're rarely a very fair fight due to... Higher level robots and guns. And I can't really help it because you gotta win to get money. But you can't win without the money...

Update8/2022: I have technical issues with the game and no answers in the articles provided in help section. I've contacted the customer service via help section but no response for a couple of days. Spent money on this game and disappointed with the terrible service! ---- This game is awesome. It would be perfect though if I you guys could add more type of missions, not just capturing beacons and destroying enemies all the time. In all, it's a must-play Android game.

I loved this game. It was a fresh gameplay that was really fun. Though it was pay to win, progress was manageable. I've been on and off. I've had to restart my progress and it's impossible to make progress without it being excruciatingly painful. I'm getting mk3 robots in my lobbies with me still having starting robots. And with the new remastered, it's impossible to play on mobile. The lag is indescribable. DO NOT GET THIS ON MOBILE, but if you have pc, the pain is worth the fun

Great combat and cool mechs, but overall this is a terrible P2W game. Quests don't progress unless you win. So if you have a quest that needs you to capture a beacon 10 times, even if you do that in a game and lose - it doesn't count. And with the P2W aspect of being able to buy the best weapons and robots, you can spend hours and not progress at all. The game is also very buggy when it comes to ads. Most times, you will get no rewards - even after watching 10+ ads. Pathetic. And support sucks.

The game is good. I play on PC and generally, I have an ok experience. But past a certain point, the only way to move forward is to either spend your wallet or play for years. Another problem is the number of offers that pop up when I enter the game. I have click through them for like 20 seconds and they still pop up randomly after games. And the leagues are kinda dumb, how they work. Would love if those are fixed. Still like the game.

update 5/2022: Spent several hundreds in it and basically is still the same level of excitement and success. Not worth it. Update3/20/2021: the game has become a money pit for the developer. It simply requires too much money to get it to be slightly effective. You can never fully experience full throttle in this game. There is always a lack of speed or armor or ability to carry weapons. At the end you lose because of the disabilities your machine has ; not because your opponent was better.

Like the game takes quite a bit of time to get newer bots. The ranking system is flawed though. You have high ranking players that drop levels to fight opponents with sub par bots. And may I ask what is the point of the conversion in the factory. It's twice as expensive than just building the components? ****They've created a new task system that allows you to collect cash and items***

This game used to be soooo much fun, I was addicted to it and wouldn't stop playing it. But after version 3.0.1, when they added the crazily overpowered new dash robots along with the new weapons, (and the only way of obtaining those items were by components, which are way overpriced) the game became so pay to win forward that the fun was sucked right out of it. It was either spends hundreds of dollars on the game or spend the rest of your life trying to obtain a robot that you want.

Really enjoying playing but I think a couple of things need to be added to enhance teamwork. 1: some form of map screen, perhaps a button which pops up a minimap 2: team broadcasts. Ability to communicate with your team! Currently you cannot communicate with your team, so no coordination is possible. Broadcasts like 'I need help!' And 'capture beacon x!' Or 'attack x target!'

If you like upgrading your equipment and getting new robots from your meager winnings, only to see all of your work get blown away by the new, whiz-bang robot with new weaponry that SO outclasses yours, that you can try and get, or you can spend HUNDREDS of dollars to buy everything, and wallet-warriors DO, then download this game. If you like losing with the stock-model stuff to wallet-warriors, download this game. Otherwise, steer clear...and I started playing almost from the beginning!

Good game, simple controls,decent graphics, good gameplay. Ok here's the biggest problem on the go. Damn pop-up purchase offers at the beginning of your games. Grinded my guts out for a long time on a game then didn't quite read all the pop-ups, and replaced it with one linked to my Google account. Not cool. Fix this timing issue bs where it's just a steady stream of pop-up after pop-up, and that will improve the gaming experience. It sucks man

I would have rated this game at 5 stars but it seems that I've finally reached a point where there is no possible way to win. I've only been playing for 3 weeks and am at level 25 and doing fairly well I believe especially after being promoted to a leader position in an established clan with 30+ seasoned fighters. The problem is that once you actually do make a purchase, they toss you into a ring with a guy that has an unstoppable mech that can kill every single bot without any damage to itself.

Now for pay players only. This was a great game, but it is now for big spenders. They added shields and weapons that you can't defend against w/out spending money, otherwise it can take years to upgrade You get destroyed in seconds and I'm up in levels, not a newbie player. Less is more. I'm done. Deleting the game after 2 years, waste of time now.

Been playing for nearly 3 years, and it used to be a lot of fun. Now unfortunately its pay to win on a massive scale. In 3 years they have added a handful of maps and done nothing with graphics or physics. Literally the same. They did add about 100 new mechs and weapons, 99% of which are pay real money or an insane amount of premium currency, which for the most part costs money. To the tune of $75 mech "sales" for a game that hasn't been improved in years. If you skimp, you will get destroyed.

It is completely pay to win! It hooks you with decent rewards when you start off, but in the layer leagues it's impossible to win without paying thousands of dollars! It used to be a good game but the new updates in the past year have ruined it! Adding modules, stealth, flying, healing, etc have made it overcomplicated. I prefer the good old Walking War Robots from a couple years back.

What did u guys do to it, the graphics are completely messed up and blurry, I've downloaded it 2 times and it is still not good and it is laggy now. I have issues with the crafting of robots(IT TAKES FOREVER) and the prices seem a little much.This used to be my favorite game of all time but pls for the love of God fix this, I will try it one more time but if it isn't working I won't be coming back to this game. Thank you and best regards!

The targeting system is just stupid. You must manually lock onto every target. The button to manually lock is very tiny. If you don't manually lock, you end up shooting the wrong target every time. I recommend Mech Arena. It's fast paced and the interface is perfect. Leave War Robots on PC where it belongs. The maps are way too large for a mobile screen.

Not really cross-platform, that is only for match making, not match invites & clans. Playing with a cross-platform family member is the only reason I got this game. I also don't like that you can only find friends via FACEBOOK. I don't use FB on mobile. The upsides: Beautiful graphics. Fun to play. I like that you can play ads for in game goodies, they don't interrupt normal gameplay. If they can truly make this cross-platform I would change to 4 stars.

""WARNING"" This game requires excessive amounts of real wold money to win. It is advertised as a free to play game, which it is free to play, but if you actually want to win at it be prepared to spend thousands of dollars. Take this advice or not but I am a 4 year player and have spent in excess of a $1000 over the course of that time and still can't compete or keep up the constant changes in the game. It's honestly one of the best games out but also the most expensive. Sadly uninstalling.

Been playing WR for about two years now. It was a really great game when I first started playing, but they've consistently made it worse ever since. With every update they make it harder for free players to be competitive in a single lifetime. They want players spending money (a lot of money), and if they don't, the game loses appeal quickly. The methods are a bit shady too, like placing you in outmatched gameplay situations with the hope you'll buy/spend money out of pure frustration.

MAKE ALL ROBOTS AFFORDABLE IN GOLD PLEASE! Anyway...this game has good graphics, a very nice, flushed out, unique set of robots to choose from, and has fun gameplay overall. However, as of right now the balance of power is way off, the economy is in shambles, and the game has turned into a mostly "pay-to-win" experience. I would give this game a 2.5 (compared to my 5 when the game was just starting), but that's not how this works...

I absolutely adored this game. It was like no other, a new experience with impressive graphics and robots and weapons but then they started adding in new weapons, robots and all that. Now, it's just pay to win, if not pay to play. I am frequently getting hit and within a few seconds I am already down. This was good but the p2w and the horribly lopsided matchmaking just doesnt mix at all with what the game is supposed to be.

Ever evolving game designed with one single aim: to get you to buy an ever changing assortment of in-game weapons, modules, perks, robots, and anything else Pixonic can dream up to win. Why? Because unless you pay, you lose which in turn has created a whole class of pay to win (P2W) players. Makes console games look like chump change! Take note: this is a very, very (emphasis on very) expensive rabbit hole. You have been warned!

Walking War Robots used to be a game about, well you guess it, Walking Robots capable of destruction, but now it just seems like the people who do the most destruction are the people with the biggest wallets. The game is all about who can buy the bigger weapons and such, back when I played when the game first dropped, it was hard, but enjoyable, you could get everything you needed to win by making your load out strategic, but that strategy is long gone, when you can spend cash to win.

This was one of my favorite games. It was even one of the best games on mobile in my opinion, it was fair and it was a downright tactical game. But after a while, when the game started to pick up. The resorted to pay to win tactics. Introducing overpowered robots. That you have to buy, making it so upgrading powerfull robots is impossible without spending money. Also including the battle pass. Its so sad to see a great game completly thrown in the trash.

Beware. Played this game for a long time. Game's fun. Was fun when I started. Can still be, as long as you don't have any issues that require you to interact with the people behind the scenes. App kept dropping me from game, had to delete/re-download it. However, leaving battles for any reason whatsoever causes you to be placed into low priority queue, you get virtually no prizes and have to battle with other "Undesirables" any level or gear score, making the experience very unpleasant. Explained this to the help staff, they accused me of trying to lower my league status on purpose. Why anyone would do that, I have no idea. I've been placed in low priority pretty much indefinitely, so I'm leaving the game. Why play if I cant have fun? Waste of time. I believe that Pixonic cares nothing about their customers and won't take time to address your issues, should you contact them and actually get past the generic, auto-generated responses. They're lazy and unmovable, reciting the "rules" by which you must abide over and over. I hope new players consider this before downloading this app and investing a lot of time and/or money for junk service. Thanks for reading.

I enjoy this game alot. But I have changed my review based on the fact the crate openings in the game are obviously rigged. It always glitches then stops on the least possible reward. I have used it dozens of times at various levels and it is always the same result. A hesitation in the rotation and it stops on one of the least rewards. I find it very disappointing that they feel it necessary to do business this way.

I think this game is worth the size. War robots is easily the best mobile game out there! At least, that was before a lot of the newer stuff came out and they had a mechanic with puzzle pieces to get the newer stuff that required a lot of grinding and delayed acquisition of stuff untill you got fed up with it. They should have just made it gold or silver instead of introducing the new puzzle piece currency.

Well overall it's a decent game to pass the time and I actually do enjoy it. However the match making is a bit wonky sometimes. Need to find a way to fix that. And also some of the weapons and bots are very pay to play as in you don't buy you probably wont ever get them lol but still alot you can and will get that's plenty of fun to use and do some damage. Waiting times on upgrades are extremely long and annoying but as a time passer overall it's a good game.

Ooooooh boy. This game is garbage. I played it a couple years ago and it was perfectly fine. I get a new, more powerful phone of the same model and all of a sudden the graphics become grainy, i freeze all the time, and I had to manually force restart my phone. Pay to win. Honestly. I used to live this game. I've now had it on four different devices and always happy to restart. No need to back up to another accou t because it's fun at every level. Previously I rated the game 5 stars, gameplay is great, graphics are great, and controls are all wonderful. But it's the currency that ruins it. There are a ton of tanks that are very good, but they need their own type of currency (which is very hard to get) in high amounts which makes it incredibly hard to unlock. The rest of the game however is outstanding.

Controls are very sticky. I could not be touching the fire buttons at all but if I touch an area near it I fire all my weapons uncontrollably. Map design is my pet peeve, certain sides of the map feel advantageous than the other on certain game modes. One side of the map can dominate the other side no matter what, and when you are on the other side, you are pushed into a corner and forced to hide and be picked off one by one. Gameplay is okay, the leveling system could be redone. I don't want this game to feel like a money grab forcing you to buy/spend gold if you want to be at the top (which it's starting to feel like now that I'm lvl 18). I'd rather prefer a balanced system, so that wether you're impatient or want to grind to the tOP, its achievable rather than having it way too unobtainable. Aiming feels solid... when the other person isn't on a higher or lower floor than you. I wish that you could adjust the camera to point up or down as well, but you are always forced to comply with the games auto aim, which may or may not work depending on the fight. Matchmaking (or mechanics) could be reworked to. I swear, the people you are up against can go in guns blazing yelling "charge!", take a few people down, and die in a glorious blaze, but if you try to do the same, you are already running away before you even have a chance to pop around the corner. I even tried leveling my mech and weapons to match up to those people who always seem to have a leg up, but it feels like the game doesn't like that, and puts me up against people that will always be better than me. Movement feels clunky, too slow paced. Could be revamped with new movement controls. Hell, new maps could be catered to it. I wouldn't mind some rooftop action or something similar (try not to fall off folks). I would like to talk about other things, like animation, graphics; I'm surprised the game has rag doll physics;; but in all honesty, playability and replay value are more of a concern to me. Especially for a game that feels like I'll have an awesome experience but doesn't deliver as soon as I jump in Tl;dr ::: the game is enjoyable when it feels like an even fight. Not knowing who might take you down, planning your moves, and watching as their canopy explodes as their pilot ejects, feels satisfying. I would prefer if their mech blows up into oblivion. But when you have to deal with a leveling system that feels way to slow and unencouraging if you grind and enjoy the experience, a map layout that caters to one side of the map, a matchmaking (or mechanic system) that just leaves you with loss after loss;; you end up turning off your phone, wondering whether or not if you'll ever go back to play it again.

It used to be a fun game, and still is to a certain extent, but now with all of these new robots and weapons requiring puzzle pieces that take months to earn or $100 upfront, and loot boxes being a straight scam, it ruins the game. The developers treat the players poorly and. If you check the game's facebook page, you can read about what has been done to players. At one point this game offered a moderate amount of entertainment for the time invested it playing. However, over the last 6 months the rewards one would receive for their effort have been removed, and many of the issues players have are worse than ever. Here are some of the issues. The cash price for many of the in-game purchases get up to $99.99 for just 1 robot. On top of that, if it is a robot or weapon you buy, it will literally require months of real time to "upgrade" the level of your purchase to a point where it is effective in combat, or you will need to spend as much or more to "speed up" its upgrade. Rewards are now few and far between, and the effort required to obtain them have raise exponentially, and after the latest update you get even less for your effort. The system used to determine random prizes for the games of chance in the game give very small prizes. The only way a player will receive a higher tier prize will be to spend real money and play a couple hundred times. Connection with the game is also an issue. Even if you are connected to thru WiFi with an exceptional signal strength; you will have connection issues. For me the game has lost its appeal. Too much effort with extremely little reward.

Also, Pixonic keeps releasing new bots that overpower the older bots so the upgrade treadmill never ends. Yes you can upgrade for 'free' but it will take you many many hours of playing and it will take a long time - possibly years to upgrade just your base hanger. However, you can still have a lot of fun without spending any money (or spending just a bit of money). Don't worry about upgrading your bots. Just upgrade as an when you are able to. You will find that the power kick you get from upgrading your weapons or bots is very brief. Soon you match up with opponents much stronger than you again so don't worry if you are in Gold, Expert, or Masters as long as you feel you are having fun. The best part of the game is Skirmish mode. Skirmish mode appears as an option periodically and you get bots selected by Pixonic and everyone has the same bots. This is my favorite part of the game.

There is an incredibly wide variety of robots and weapons, but progress on unlocking them is so slow or so expensive that advancing in the game is stagnant. I'm not opposed to dropping a few bucks here or there on a great game like this, but asking $100 for a single robot or $75 for a single weapon is downright absurd and turns new players away the moment they see it. Unlocking things for free means playing extensively and still waiting 5 weeks for the components to complete, and that's if you're far enough to have leveled up your workshop to handle larger orders. I'm not opposed to throwing money into a game I enjoy, especially one like this. However, when I have to take out a small loan just to shave some time off the production clock I'll leave my wallet in my back pocket.

I originally reviewed this game on 9/17/2017. I am going back through the game again to see if there have been any changes to make it better. Sadly, aside from some graphics tweaks, there is not much in the way of improvements. Unless you consider selling power creep (in the form of more powerful boots and weapons) an improvement. After starting over from scratch, I have found that it now takes 2-3 times longer to get some weapons and boots, than it used to. The components system is designed to be a bigger grind than it was originally to grind for gold. The "Premium" membership is still a joke. Only 50% silver and experience? I was really hoping they would at least do something to make this worth the price. But it's not. Silver and experience is extremely easy to come by. That is actually the easiest grind in the game. Just play matches, and you get it after each one. Weapons I used to be able to get within 1-1.5 weeks now take about 3-4 weeks of grinding to get. Timers for upgrading stuff are still so long, it's just stupid. The projects you start in the "Work Shop" take 20 hours each. I know that they are using these ridiculous time gates to try and push players into spending real life money to speed up the process. But at some point, you have to use a little common sense as a developer. Recently they changed things in the game that had some of the timers running at a fairly decent level. Unfortunately, the developers nerfed it. The match making system is still the worse. There are leagues that you can progress through. But they are pointless. When you enter a match, you (and everyone else on your team) may be in the lowest tier of the league, but you might be against another team with all maxed bots and gear. It's a slaughterfest for them. Overall, if you want a game that you don't care about extreme grinds, or you just want to blow money in on power creep, then you will love this game. But, if you prefer a game that is more fun than work, then you might want to check somewhere else. This has been a Razar review. Razar.

I am writing an honest review here. This game is a fun and addictive shooter game with robots for every play style. Some say it is borderline unplayable. I have to disagree, because I have tested it on a variety of Android devices many of which cannot handle the game well. I suggest you have a device with at least 2 GB of ram and a Quad-Core 1.8 GHz processor or better. Keep it at minimal/30 fps and it should be great. I have played on iDevices too. The game seems to be highly optimized for the IOS platform mainly because of the minimal releases apple has compared to the thousands of androids that may be landfill quality. I have been playing the game for a few years now. It has gotten very competitive due to overpowered robots and weapons. take it from me, the best advice I can give is UPGRADE YOUR ROBOTS AND WEAPONS! It is absolutely necessary. I know there can be many quality of life improvements as well, like being able to adjust the resolution scale manually which can significantly increase performance on some older devices as well as newer ones. Another thing I would like to see is matchmaking made to where Free to Players get matched with Free to Players and Pay to winners with pay to winners. It would make game play fairer than it can be now. But I do have to say, it can be very fun to plot a take down that will demolish the pay to winners. I would like to see the Ao Jun to be tweaked to do damage that couldn't take out entire titans in one go. Another thing that can boost performance is removing other visual elements like weapon trails and particles. In the end the game requires practice and strategy to be enjoyable. In my opinion no robot is obsolete in any way; just make tactics that can utilize abilities (or lack-there-of in some cases.) I would love to see the whole pilot and drone thing be nerfed though. It can be cumbersome and resource heavy. I do hope I have given some help to others and the devs at pixonic and appreciate you for getting to the end. -Stev0n

Computer grade 5v5 multiplayer game. this type of games are rarely seen on the Android platform. Rounds are quick at 10 minutes, 3rd person view 3d shooter with quick thinking and strategy, knowing your robot's and weapon abilities, knowing what the enemy robot in front of you can do. Being aware of your surroundings and knowing if you're in a disadvantage and should retreat or press on the attack All while being a free game. The other side of the coin of the game being free is that almost everything cost time and silver (free money that you get by playing battles), getting slots for additional robots, upgrading robot's speed and health, upgrading or buying weapons all cost silver. You can of course speed everything up by using real money but it is not necessary. The only tip I would give is too consider buying a 30 or 10 days vip which is cheap and gives you more silver per battle (%50) if you know you're going to play a lot since I found that I get more silver with vip to be able to do lots of stuff i wasn't able to do before. Before buying vip I had to play lots of games and really plan what to do with the silver, buying vip really took the pressure off of that and for the single time I bought it after years of playing the game I think it's a good spending of money.
